name: TunnellMap.vadd_eq_two_vsmul_of_halfSum
statement:
theorem vadd_eq_two_vsmul_of_halfSum {h E F : Triple}
    (hh : IsHalfSum h E F) : vadd E F = vsmul 2 h
proof:
:= by
  rcases hh with ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
  apply Triple.ext <;> simp [vadd, vsmul] at hx hy hz ⊢ <;> omega

name: TunnellMap.halfDiff_is_halfSum_neg
statement:
theorem halfDiff_is_halfSum_neg {h E F : Triple}
    (hh : IsHalfDiff h E F) : IsHalfSum h E (negTriple F)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hh with ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
  exact ⟨by simpa [negTriple, sub_eq_add_neg] using hx,
    by simpa [negTriple, sub_eq_add_neg] using hy,
    by simpa [negTriple, sub_eq_add_neg] using hz⟩

name: TunnellMap.preferred_midpoint_record_of_half
statement:
theorem preferred_midpoint_record_of_half {n : ℤ} (hn : Odd n)
    (s : BResidual n) (t target : AResidual n) (htarget : target = preferredTarget s t)
    (h : Triple) (hodd : Odd h.z)
    (hhalf : IsHalfSum h (residualSourceLift s) (residualTargetLift target))
    (hpref : preferredVector s t = vsmul 2 h) :
    Nonempty (PreferredMidpointRecord s t)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : h ≠ ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ := odd_third_ne_zero hodd
  let d := primitiveDirection h
  let q := directionScale h
  have hdec : h = vsmul q d := direction_decomposition h
  have hdir : d = primitiveDirection (preferredVector s t) := by
    rw [hpref, primitiveDirection_two_vsmul hne]
  have hqne : q ≠ 0 := directionScale_ne_zero hne
  have hzprod : h.z = q * d.z := congrArg Triple.z hdec
  have hprodOdd : Odd (q * d.z) := by
    rw [← hzprod]
    exact hodd
  have hqodd : Odd q := (Int.odd_mul.mp hprodOdd).1
  have hdodd : Odd d.z := (Int.odd_mul.mp hprodOdd).2
  have hfirst : FirstNonzeroPositive d := by
    exact orientDirection_firstNonzeroPositive (primitivePartTriple_ne_zero hne)
  have hline : vadd (residualSourceLift s) (residualTargetLift target) =
      vsmul (2 * q) d := by
    calc
      vadd (residualSourceLift s) (residualTargetLift target) = vsmul 2 h :=
        vadd_eq_two_vsmul_of_halfSum hhalf
      _ = vsmul 2 (vsmul q d) := by rw [hdec]
      _ = vsmul (2 * q) d := by ext <;> simp [vsmul] <;> ring
  have hnorm : qForm (residualTargetLift target) = qForm (residualSourceLift s) := by
    simp [residualTargetLift, residualSourceLift]
  have hscale := endpoint_scale_equation hnorm (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hqne)
    (Or.inl hline)
  have hbilinear : qBilinear (residualSourceLift s) d = q * qForm d := by
    nlinarith
  have htargetFormula : residualTargetLift target =
      vadd (negTriple (residualSourceLift s)) (vsmul (2 * q) d) := by
    apply Triple.ext
    · have hx := congrArg Triple.x hline
      simp [vadd, vsmul, negTriple] at hx ⊢
      linarith
    · have hy := congrArg Triple.y hline
      simp [vadd, vsmul, negTriple] at hy ⊢
      linarith
    · have hz := congrArg Triple.z hline
      simp [vadd, vsmul, negTriple] at hz ⊢
      linarith
  have hbound := preferred_midpoint_generator_bound hn s t
  refine ⟨{
    target := target
    target_eq := htarget
    half := h
    half_odd := hodd
    half_sum := hhalf
    direction := d
    multiplier := q
    direction_eq := hdir
    half_decomposition := hdec
    multiplier_odd := hqodd
    direction_third_odd := hdodd
    direction_oriented := hfirst
    bilinear := hbilinear
    target_formula := htargetFormula
    direction_bound := ?_ }⟩
  simpa [hdir] using hbound

name: TunnellMap.exists_preferred_midpoint_record
statement:
theorem exists_preferred_midpoint_record {n : ℤ} (hn : Odd n)
    (s : BResidual n) (t : AResidual n) :
    Nonempty (PreferredMidpointRecord s t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hPlus, hMinus, hPlusEq, hPlusOdd, hMinusEq, hMinusOdd⟩ :=
    midpoint_parity hn s.1 t.1
  by_cases hkey : directionKey (plusVector s t) < directionKey (minusVector s t)
  · have htarget : t = preferredTarget s t := by simp [preferredTarget, hkey]
    have hpref : preferredVector s t = vsmul 2 hPlus := by
      rw [show preferredVector s t = plusVector s t by simp [preferredVector, hkey]]
      exact plusVector_eq_two_vsmul_of_halfSum s t hPlus hPlusEq
    exact preferred_midpoint_record_of_half hn s t t htarget hPlus hPlusOdd hPlusEq hpref
  · have htarget : negAResidual t = preferredTarget s t := by
      simp [preferredTarget, hkey]
    have hhalf : IsHalfSum hMinus (residualSourceLift s)
        (residualTargetLift (negAResidual t)) := by
      rw [residualTargetLift_neg]
      exact halfDiff_is_halfSum_neg hMinusEq
    have hpref : preferredVector s t = vsmul 2 hMinus := by
      rw [show preferredVector s t = minusVector s t by simp [preferredVector, hkey]]
      exact minusVector_eq_two_vsmul_of_halfDiff s t hMinus hMinusEq
    exact preferred_midpoint_record_of_half hn s t (negAResidual t) htarget
      hMinus hMinusOdd hhalf hpref

name: TunnellMap.qForm_bLift
statement: @[simp] theorem qForm_bLift {n : ℤ} (p : BOddRep n) : qForm (bLift p) = n
proof:
:= by
  have h := p.2.1
  change 2 * p.1.x ^ 2 + p.1.y ^ 2 + 8 * p.1.z ^ 2 = n at h
  change 2 * p.1.x ^ 2 + p.1.y ^ 2 + 2 * (2 * p.1.z) ^ 2 = n
  nlinarith

name: TunnellMap.qForm_aLift
statement: @[simp] theorem qForm_aLift {n : ℤ} (p : ARep n) : qForm (aLift p) = n
proof:
:= by
  have h := p.2
  change 2 * p.1.x ^ 2 + p.1.y ^ 2 + 32 * p.1.z ^ 2 = n at h
  change 2 * p.1.x ^ 2 + p.1.y ^ 2 + 2 * (4 * p.1.z) ^ 2 = n
  nlinarith

name: TunnellMap.odd_sq_eq_one_add_eight_mul
statement:
theorem odd_sq_eq_one_add_eight_mul {x : ℤ} (hx : Odd x) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, x ^ 2 = 1 + 8 * k
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨a, ha⟩
  rcases Int.even_mul_succ_self a with ⟨k, hk⟩
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  calc
    x ^ 2 = (2 * a + 1) ^ 2 := by rw [ha]
    _ = 1 + 4 * (a * (a + 1)) := by ring
    _ = 1 + 8 * k := by rw [hk]; ring

name: TunnellMap.even_sq_eq_four_mul
statement:
theorem even_sq_eq_four_mul {x : ℤ} (hx : Even x) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, x ^ 2 = 4 * k
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨a, ha⟩
  refine ⟨a ^ 2, ?_⟩
  rw [ha]
  ring

name: TunnellMap.lifted_first_coordinates_same_parity
statement:
theorem lifted_first_coordinates_same_parity {n : ℤ} (hn : Odd n)
    (s : BOddRep n) (t : ARep n) :
    (Even s.1.x ∧ Even t.1.x) ∨ (Odd s.1.x ∧ Odd t.1.x)
proof:
:= by
  have hsy := odd_y_of_bOdd hn s
  have hty := odd_y_of_aRep hn t
  rcases Int.even_or_odd s.1.x with hsx | hsx
  · rcases Int.even_or_odd t.1.x with htx | htx
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hsx, htx⟩
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨ksx, hsx₂⟩ := even_sq_eq_four_mul hsx
      obtain ⟨ktx, htx₂⟩ := odd_sq_eq_one_add_eight_mul htx
      obtain ⟨ksy, hsy₂⟩ := odd_sq_eq_one_add_eight_mul hsy
      obtain ⟨kty, hty₂⟩ := odd_sq_eq_one_add_eight_mul hty
      have hsform := s.2.1
      have htform := t.2
      change 2 * s.1.x ^ 2 + s.1.y ^ 2 + 8 * s.1.z ^ 2 = n at hsform
      change 2 * t.1.x ^ 2 + t.1.y ^ 2 + 32 * t.1.z ^ 2 = n at htform
      rw [hsx₂, hsy₂] at hsform
      rw [htx₂, hty₂] at htform
      omega
  · rcases Int.even_or_odd t.1.x with htx | htx
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨ksx, hsx₂⟩ := odd_sq_eq_one_add_eight_mul hsx
      obtain ⟨ktx, htx₂⟩ := even_sq_eq_four_mul htx
      obtain ⟨ksy, hsy₂⟩ := odd_sq_eq_one_add_eight_mul hsy
      obtain ⟨kty, hty₂⟩ := odd_sq_eq_one_add_eight_mul hty
      have hsform := s.2.1
      have htform := t.2
      change 2 * s.1.x ^ 2 + s.1.y ^ 2 + 8 * s.1.z ^ 2 = n at hsform
      change 2 * t.1.x ^ 2 + t.1.y ^ 2 + 32 * t.1.z ^ 2 = n at htform
      rw [hsx₂, hsy₂] at hsform
      rw [htx₂, hty₂] at htform
      omega
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hsx, htx⟩

name: TunnellMap.midpoint_parity
statement:
theorem midpoint_parity {n : ℤ} (hn : Odd n) (s : BOddRep n) (t : ARep n) :
    ∃ hPlus hMinus : Triple,
      IsHalfSum hPlus (bLift s) (aLift t) ∧ Odd hPlus.z ∧
      IsHalfDiff hMinus (bLift s) (aLift t) ∧ Odd hMinus.z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sy, hsy⟩ := odd_y_of_bOdd hn s
  obtain ⟨ty, hty⟩ := odd_y_of_aRep hn t
  obtain ⟨sz, hsz⟩ := s.2.2
  rcases lifted_first_coordinates_same_parity hn s t with hEven | hOdd
  · obtain ⟨⟨sx, hsx⟩, ⟨tx, htx⟩⟩ := hEven
    refine ⟨⟨sx + tx, sy + ty + 1, s.1.z + 2 * t.1.z⟩,
      ⟨sx - tx, sy - ty, s.1.z - 2 * t.1.z⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · dsimp [IsHalfSum, bLift, aLift]
        omega
      · constructor <;> dsimp [bLift, aLift] <;> omega
    · refine ⟨sz + t.1.z, ?_⟩
      dsimp
      omega
    · constructor
      · dsimp [IsHalfDiff, bLift, aLift]
        omega
      · constructor <;> dsimp [bLift, aLift] <;> omega
    · refine ⟨sz - t.1.z, ?_⟩
      dsimp
      omega
  · obtain ⟨⟨sx, hsx⟩, ⟨tx, htx⟩⟩ := hOdd
    refine ⟨⟨sx + tx + 1, sy + ty + 1, s.1.z + 2 * t.1.z⟩,
      ⟨sx - tx, sy - ty, s.1.z - 2 * t.1.z⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · dsimp [IsHalfSum, bLift, aLift]
        omega
      · constructor <;> dsimp [bLift, aLift] <;> omega
    · refine ⟨sz + t.1.z, ?_⟩
      dsimp
      omega
    · constructor
      · dsimp [IsHalfDiff, bLift, aLift]
        omega
      · constructor <;> dsimp [bLift, aLift] <;> omega
    · refine ⟨sz - t.1.z, ?_⟩
      dsimp
      omega

name: TunnellMap.odd_third_ne_zero
statement: theorem odd_third_ne_zero {p : Triple} (hp : Odd p.z) : p ≠ ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hz : p.z = 0 := congrArg Triple.z h
  rw [hz] at hp
  exact Int.not_odd_zero hp

name: TunnellMap.Examples41.tripleEqExec_iff
statement: theorem tripleEqExec_iff (u w : Triple) : tripleEqExec u w = true ↔ u = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := u
  obtain ⟨a', b', c'⟩ := w
  simp only [tripleEqExec, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, Triple.mk.injEq,
    and_assoc]

name: TunnellMap.Examples41.reconstructFromHeld_eq_inverseByRerun_body
statement:
theorem reconstructFromHeld_eq_inverseByRerun_body
    (held : Triple → Option (BResidual 41 × IncidentRecord))
    (fallback : BResidual 41) (y : AResidual 41) :
    (held (canonicalTargetLift (residualTargetLift y))).elim fallback
        (fun p => signActB (targetLiftSign (residualTargetLift y) * p.2.sign) p.1) =
      (reconstructFromHeld held y).getD fallback
proof:
:= by
  unfold reconstructFromHeld
  cases held (canonicalTargetLift (residualTargetLift y)) <;> rfl

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.mem_blockIndexList
statement:
theorem mem_blockIndexList (n : ℤ) (F : OrthogonalFrame p) (h : ℤ)
    (i : GeneratorIndex) :
    i ∈ blockIndexList n F h ↔
      i.A = h ∧ i.q ∈ qValues n h ∧ i.b ∈ bValues n F h i.q ∧
        i.u ∈ rootValues F h i.q i.b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blockIndexList, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_sort]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, b, hb, u, hu, hi⟩
    subst hi
    exact ⟨rfl, hq, hb, hu⟩
  · rintro ⟨hA, hq, hb, hu⟩
    exact ⟨i.q, hq, i.b, hb, i.u, hu, by cases i; simp_all⟩

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockIndexList_nodup
statement:
theorem blockIndexList_nodup (n : ℤ) (F : OrthogonalFrame p) (h : ℤ) :
    (blockIndexList n F h).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockIndexList, List.nodup_flatMap]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q _
    rw [List.nodup_flatMap]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro b _
      refine (Finset.sort_nodup _ _).map ?_
      intro u v huv
      exact congrArg GeneratorIndex.u huv
    · refine (Finset.sort_nodup (bValues n F h q) (· ≤ ·)).imp ?_
      intro b₁ b₂ hne
      simp only [Function.onFun]
      intro i hi₁ hi₂
      simp only [List.mem_map] at hi₁ hi₂
      obtain ⟨u₁, -, h₁⟩ := hi₁
      obtain ⟨u₂, -, h₂⟩ := hi₂
      exact hne (by
        have := congrArg GeneratorIndex.b (h₁.trans h₂.symm)
        simpa using this)
  · refine (Finset.sort_nodup (qValues n h) (· ≤ ·)).imp ?_
    intro q₁ q₂ hne
    simp only [Function.onFun]
    intro i hi₁ hi₂
    simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map] at hi₁ hi₂
    obtain ⟨b₁, -, u₁, -, h₁⟩ := hi₁
    obtain ⟨b₂, -, u₂, -, h₂⟩ := hi₂
    exact hne (by
      have := congrArg GeneratorIndex.q (h₁.trans h₂.symm)
      simpa using this)

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.mem_rawIndices_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rawIndices_iff (n : ℤ) (F : OrthogonalFrame p) (i : GeneratorIndex) :
    i ∈ rawIndices n F ↔
      (1 ≤ i.A ∧ i.A ≤ hMax n) ∧ i ∈ blockIndexList n F i.A
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_rawIndices, mem_blockIndexList]
  simp only [AValues, mem_intIcc, hMax, true_and]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockIndexList_q_ne_zero
statement:
theorem blockIndexList_q_ne_zero {n : ℤ} {F : OrthogonalFrame p} {h : ℤ}
    {i : GeneratorIndex} (hi : i ∈ blockIndexList n F h) : i.q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq := ((mem_blockIndexList n F h i).mp hi).2.1
  rw [qValues, Finset.mem_filter] at hq
  exact hq.2.1

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockIndexList_A
statement:
theorem blockIndexList_A {n : ℤ} {F : OrthogonalFrame p} {h : ℤ}
    {i : GeneratorIndex} (hi : i ∈ blockIndexList n F h) : i.A = h
proof:
:=
  ((mem_blockIndexList n F h i).mp hi).1

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.dValue_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  rw [hzero] at hgcd
  simp [tripleGcd] at hgcd

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.plusVector_eq_vsmul
statement:
theorem plusVector_eq_vsmul (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (i : GeneratorIndex) (t : AResidual n)
    (ht : residualTargetLift t = targetValue s F i) :
    plusVector s t = vsmul (2 * i.q) (dValue F i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [plusVector, ht]
  unfold targetValue reconstructedTarget
  apply Triple.ext <;> simp [vadd, vsmul, negTriple]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.retained_iff_passesFilters
statement:
theorem retained_iff_passesFilters
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {i : GeneratorIndex} (hq : i.q ≠ 0) :
    Retained s F i ↔ PassesFilters s F i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (isResidualTargetLift_iff n (targetValue s F i)).mp h5
    have hd0 : dValue F i ≠ ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ := dValue_ne_zero h2
    have hkeyd : primitiveKey (dValue F i) = directionKey (dValue F i) :=
      primitiveKey_eq_directionKey h2 h3
    have hplus : plusVector s t = vsmul (2 * i.q) (dValue F i) :=
      plusVector_eq_vsmul F i t ht
    have hplusKey : directionKey (plusVector s t) = directionKey (dValue F i) := by
      rw [hplus]
      exact directionKey_vsmul (by omega) hd0
    have hminus : minusVector s t = vsub (residualSourceLift s) (targetValue s F i) := by
      rw [minusVector, ht]
    have hminusKey : directionKeyExec
        (vsub (residualSourceLift s) (targetValue s F i)) =
        directionKey (minusVector s t) := by
      rw [← hminus]
      exact directionKeyExec_eq (minusVector_ne_zero s t)
    refine ⟨h1, by rw [tripleContent_eq_tripleGcd]; exact h2, h3, h4, t, ht, ?_⟩
    have hlt : directionKey (plusVector s t) < directionKey (minusVector s t) := by
      rw [hplusKey, ← hkeyd, ← hminusKey]
      exact h6
    rw [representativeEdgeKey, min_eq_left hlt.le, hplusKey]
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, t, ht, hkey⟩
    have h2' : tripleGcd (dValue F i) = 1 := by
      rw [← tripleContent_eq_tripleGcd]; exact h2
    have hd0 : dValue F i ≠ ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ := dValue_ne_zero h2'
    have hkeyd : primitiveKey (dValue F i) = directionKey (dValue F i) :=
      primitiveKey_eq_directionKey h2' h3
    have hplus : plusVector s t = vsmul (2 * i.q) (dValue F i) :=
      plusVector_eq_vsmul F i t ht
    have hplusKey : directionKey (plusVector s t) = directionKey (dValue F i) := by
      rw [hplus]
      exact directionKey_vsmul (by omega) hd0
    have hminus : minusVector s t = vsub (residualSourceLift s) (targetValue s F i) := by
      rw [minusVector, ht]
    have hminusKey : directionKeyExec
        (vsub (residualSourceLift s) (targetValue s F i)) =
        directionKey (minusVector s t) := by
      rw [← hminus]
      exact directionKeyExec_eq (minusVector_ne_zero s t)
    refine ⟨h1, h2', h3, h4, (isResidualTargetLift_iff n _).mpr ⟨t, ht⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hkeyd, hminusKey]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (directionKey (plusVector s t))
      (directionKey (minusVector s t)) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · rwa [← hplusKey]
    · exact absurd heq (plus_minus_keys_ne s t)
    · exfalso
      rw [representativeEdgeKey, min_eq_right hgt.le] at hkey
      rw [← hplusKey] at hkey
      exact plus_minus_keys_ne s t hkey

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.emit_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem emit_eq_some_iff (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {i : GeneratorIndex} {r : IncidentRecord} :
    emit s F i = some r ↔ Retained s F i ∧ r = recordOf s F i
proof:
:= by
  unfold emit
  by_cases h : Retained s F i <;> simp [h, eq_comm]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.mem_blockRetained
statement:
theorem mem_blockRetained (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (h : ℤ) (i : GeneratorIndex) :
    i ∈ blockRetained s F h ↔ i ∈ blockIndexList n F h ∧ Retained s F i
proof:
:= by
  simp [blockRetained]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockRetained_nodup
statement:
theorem blockRetained_nodup (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (h : ℤ) : (blockRetained s F h).Nodup
proof:
:=
  List.Nodup.filter _ (blockIndexList_nodup n F h)

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.filterMap_emit_eq
statement:
theorem filterMap_emit_eq (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) (h : ℤ) :
    (blockIndexList n F h).filterMap (emit s F) =
      (blockRetained s F h).map (recordOf s F)
proof:
:= by
  unfold blockRetained
  induction blockIndexList n F h with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih => by_cases ha : Retained s F a <;> simp [emit, ha, ih]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockRecords_perm
statement:
theorem blockRecords_perm (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) (h : ℤ) :
    (blockRecords s F h).Perm ((blockRetained s F h).map (recordOf s F))
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockRecords, ← filterMap_emit_eq]
  exact List.mergeSort_perm _ _

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.recordLe_trans
statement:
theorem recordLe_trans (a b c : IncidentRecord) :
    recordLe a b = true → recordLe b c = true → recordLe a c = true
proof:
:= by
  simp only [recordLe, keyLeExec_iff]
  exact le_trans

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.recordLe_total
statement:
theorem recordLe_total (a b : IncidentRecord) :
    (recordLe a b || recordLe b a) = true
proof:
:= by
  simp only [recordLe, Bool.or_eq_true, keyLeExec_iff]
  exact le_total _ _

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockRecords_pairwise_le
statement:
theorem blockRecords_pairwise_le (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (h : ℤ) : (blockRecords s F h).Pairwise fun a b => a.key ≤ b.key
proof:
:= by
  have := List.pairwise_mergeSort recordLe_trans recordLe_total
    ((blockIndexList n F h).filterMap (emit s F))
  exact this.imp (by simp only [recordLe, keyLeExec_iff]; exact id)

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.mem_validIndices_of_block
proof:
:= by
  have hA : i.A = h := blockIndexList_A hi
  rw [mem_validIndices_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, (retained_iff_passesFilters F (blockIndexList_q_ne_zero hi)).mp hr⟩
  rw [mem_rawIndices_iff]
  exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by rw [hA]; exact hi⟩

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.block_of_mem_validIndices
statement:
theorem block_of_mem_validIndices (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {i : GeneratorIndex} (hi : i ∈ validIndices s F) :
    1 ≤ i.A ∧ i.A ≤ hMax n ∧ i ∈ blockIndexList n F i.A ∧ Retained s F i
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_validIndices_iff] at hi
  obtain ⟨hraw, hpf⟩ := hi
  rw [mem_rawIndices_iff] at hraw
  exact ⟨hraw.1.1, hraw.1.2, hraw.2,
    (retained_iff_passesFilters F (blockIndexList_q_ne_zero hraw.2)).mpr hpf⟩

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.recordOf_key_of_valid
statement:
theorem recordOf_key_of_valid (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {i : GeneratorIndex} (hi : i ∈ validIndices s F) :
    (recordOf s F i).key = directionKey (dValue F i)
proof:
:= by
  have hpf := ((mem_validIndices_iff s F i).mp hi).2
  exact primitiveKey_eq_directionKey
    (by rw [← tripleContent_eq_tripleGcd]; exact hpf.2.1) hpf.2.2.1

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.recordOf_key_fst
statement:
theorem recordOf_key_fst (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {i : GeneratorIndex} (hi : i ∈ validIndices s F) :
    (recordOf s F i).key.form = i.A
proof:
:= by
  have hpf := ((mem_validIndices_iff s F i).mp hi).2
  have hraw := ((mem_validIndices_iff s F i).mp hi).1
  have hfix := primitiveDirection_eq_self_of_content_one_of_oriented hpf.2.1 hpf.2.2.1
  rw [recordOf_key_of_valid F hi]
  simp only [directionKey, hfix]
  exact qForm_dValue_of_rawIndex F hraw hpf.1

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.recordOf_key_lt_of_A_lt
statement:
theorem recordOf_key_lt_of_A_lt (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {i j : GeneratorIndex} (hi : i ∈ validIndices s F) (hj : j ∈ validIndices s F)
    (hij : i.A < j.A) : (recordOf s F i).key < (recordOf s F j).key
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectionKey.lt_iff]
  exact Or.inl (by rw [recordOf_key_fst F hi, recordOf_key_fst F hj]; exact hij)

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.recordOf_injOn_valid
statement:
theorem recordOf_injOn_valid (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {i j : GeneratorIndex} (hi : i ∈ validIndices s F) (hj : j ∈ validIndices s F)
    (h : (recordOf s F i).key = (recordOf s F j).key) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  have hkey : directionKey (dValue F i) = directionKey (dValue F j) := by
    rw [← recordOf_key_of_valid F hi, ← recordOf_key_of_valid F hj]; exact h
  have := validIndex_eq_of_directionKey_eq s F ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ hkey
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.mem_blockRecords
statement:
theorem mem_blockRecords (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (h : ℤ) (r : IncidentRecord) :
    r ∈ blockRecords s F h ↔
      ∃ i, (i ∈ blockIndexList n F h ∧ Retained s F i) ∧ r = recordOf s F i
proof:
:= by
  rw [(blockRecords_perm F h).mem_iff, List.mem_map]
  simp only [mem_blockRetained]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩; exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩; exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockRecords_pairwise_key_ne
statement:
theorem blockRecords_pairwise_key_ne (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {a : ℤ} (h1 : 1 ≤ a) (h2 : a ≤ hMax n) :
    (blockRecords s F a).Pairwise fun x y => x.key ≠ y.key
proof:
:= by
  refine ((blockRecords_perm F a).pairwise_iff (fun {x y} hxy => Ne.symm hxy)).mpr ?_
  rw [List.pairwise_map]
  refine (blockRetained_nodup F a).imp_of_mem ?_
  intro i j hi hj hne hkey
  rw [mem_blockRetained] at hi hj
  exact hne (recordOf_injOn_valid F (mem_validIndices_of_block F h1 h2 hi.1 hi.2)
    (mem_validIndices_of_block F h1 h2 hj.1 hj.2) hkey)

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockRecords_pairwise_key_lt
statement:
theorem blockRecords_pairwise_key_lt (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {a : ℤ} (h1 : 1 ≤ a) (h2 : a ≤ hMax n) :
    (blockRecords s F a).Pairwise fun x y => x.key < y.key
proof:
:=
  ((blockRecords_pairwise_le F a).and (blockRecords_pairwise_key_ne F h1 h2)).imp
    fun hx => lt_of_le_of_ne hx.1 hx.2

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.mem_blockRange
statement: theorem mem_blockRange (n h x : ℤ) : x ∈ blockRange n h ↔ h ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hMax n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blockRange, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩; omega
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    exact ⟨(x - h).toNat, by omega, by omega⟩

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockRange_nil
statement: theorem blockRange_nil {n h : ℤ} (hgt : ¬ h ≤ hMax n) : blockRange n h = []
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blockRange]
  rw [show (hMax n + 1 - h).toNat = 0 by omega]
  simp

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockRange_cons
statement:
theorem blockRange_cons {n h : ℤ} (hle : h ≤ hMax n) :
    blockRange n h = h :: blockRange n (h + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blockRange]
  rw [show (hMax n + 1 - h).toNat = (hMax n + 1 - (h + 1)).toNat + 1 by omega,
    List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.map_map]
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
  congr 1
  refine List.map_congr_left ?_
  intro k _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Nat.cast_succ]
  ring

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockRange_pairwise_lt
statement: theorem blockRange_pairwise_lt (n h : ℤ) : (blockRange n h).Pairwise (· < ·)
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockRange, List.pairwise_map]
  exact List.pairwise_lt_range.imp (by intro a b hab; omega)

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blocksFrom_eq_flatMap
statement:
theorem blocksFrom_eq_flatMap (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (h : ℤ) : blocksFrom s F h = (blockRange n h).flatMap (blockRecords s F)
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ h : ℤ, (hMax n + 1 - h).toNat = k →
      blocksFrom s F h = (blockRange n h).flatMap (blockRecords s F) from H _ h rfl
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro h hk
      have hgt : ¬ h ≤ hMax n := by omega
      rw [blocksFrom, if_neg hgt, blockRange_nil hgt]
      simp
  | succ k ih =>
      intro h hk
      have hle : h ≤ hMax n := by omega
      rw [blocksFrom, if_pos hle, blockRange_cons hle, List.flatMap_cons,
        ih (h + 1) (by omega)]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.mem_blocksFrom
statement:
theorem mem_blocksFrom (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {h : ℤ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (r : IncidentRecord) :
    r ∈ blocksFrom s F h ↔
      ∃ i, i ∈ validIndices s F ∧ h ≤ i.A ∧ r = recordOf s F i
proof:
:= by
  rw [blocksFrom_eq_flatMap, List.mem_flatMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hr⟩
    rw [mem_blockRange] at ha
    rw [mem_blockRecords] at hr
    obtain ⟨i, ⟨hi, hret⟩, rfl⟩ := hr
    have hA : i.A = a := blockIndexList_A hi
    exact ⟨i, mem_validIndices_of_block F (by omega) ha.2 hi hret, by omega, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hiA, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hA1, hA2, hmem, hret⟩ := block_of_mem_validIndices F hi
    exact ⟨i.A, (mem_blockRange n h i.A).mpr ⟨hiA, hA2⟩,
      (mem_blockRecords F i.A _).mpr ⟨i, ⟨hmem, hret⟩, rfl⟩⟩

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.mem_fullTrace
statement:
theorem mem_fullTrace (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (r : IncidentRecord) :
    r ∈ fullTrace s F ↔ ∃ i, i ∈ validIndices s F ∧ r = recordOf s F i
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullTrace, mem_blocksFrom F le_rfl]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, -, hr⟩; exact ⟨i, hi, hr⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hr⟩
    exact ⟨i, hi, (block_of_mem_validIndices F hi).1, hr⟩

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blocksFrom_pairwise_key_lt
statement:
theorem blocksFrom_pairwise_key_lt (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {h : ℤ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) :
    (blocksFrom s F h).Pairwise fun x y => x.key < y.key
proof:
:= by
  rw [blocksFrom_eq_flatMap, List.pairwise_flatMap]
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    rw [mem_blockRange] at ha
    exact blockRecords_pairwise_key_lt F (by omega) ha.2
  · refine (blockRange_pairwise_lt n h).imp_of_mem ?_
    intro a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ hlt x hx y hy
    rw [mem_blockRange] at ha₁ ha₂
    rw [mem_blockRecords] at hx hy
    obtain ⟨i, ⟨hi, hri⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨j, ⟨hj, hrj⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hiA : i.A = a₁ := blockIndexList_A hi
    have hjA : j.A = a₂ := blockIndexList_A hj
    exact recordOf_key_lt_of_A_lt F
      (mem_validIndices_of_block F (by omega) ha₁.2 hi hri)
      (mem_validIndices_of_block F (by omega) ha₂.2 hj hrj) (by omega)

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.fullTrace_pairwise_key_lt
statement:
theorem fullTrace_pairwise_key_lt (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    (fullTrace s F).Pairwise fun x y => x.key < y.key
proof:
:=
  blocksFrom_pairwise_key_lt F le_rfl

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.fullTrace_nodup
statement:
theorem fullTrace_nodup (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    (fullTrace s F).Nodup
proof:
:=
  (fullTrace_pairwise_key_lt F).imp fun hxy hEq => absurd (congrArg IncidentRecord.key hEq)
    (ne_of_lt hxy)

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.orbitTargetLift_injective
statement:
theorem orbitTargetLift_injective {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) :
    Function.Injective (orbitTargetLift hnpos)
proof:
:= by
  intro o₁ o₂ h
  have ht := residualTargetLift_injective h
  calc
    o₁ = (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit
          (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos o₁) :=
      ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit_canonicalRepresentative
        aResidualLexKey aResidualLexKey_injective o₁).symm
    _ = (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit
          (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos o₂) := by rw [ht]
    _ = o₂ := (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit_canonicalRepresentative
        aResidualLexKey aResidualLexKey_injective o₂

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.recordOf_target_eq
statement:
theorem recordOf_target_eq (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (i : {i // i ∈ validIndices s F}) :
    (recordOf s F i.1).target = orbitTargetLift hnpos (targetOrbitOfValid hnpos s F i)
proof:
:= by
  show canonicalTargetLift (targetValue s F i.1) = _
  rw [← targetOfValid_lift s F i, canonicalTargetLift_eq hnpos]
  rfl

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.recordOf_sign_spec
statement:
theorem recordOf_sign_spec (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (i : GeneratorIndex) :
    targetValue s F i = vsmul (recordOf s F i).sign (recordOf s F i).target
proof:
:=
  canonicalTargetLift_spec _

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.recordOf_sign_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
theorem recordOf_sign_eq_one_or_neg_one
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) (i : GeneratorIndex) :
    (recordOf s F i).sign = 1 ∨ (recordOf s F i).sign = -1
proof:
:=
  targetLiftSign_mem _

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.orderedIndexList_map_pairwise_key_lt
statement:
theorem orderedIndexList_map_pairwise_key_lt
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    ((orderedIndexList s F).map fun i => recordOf s F i.1).Pairwise
      fun x y => x.key < y.key
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.pairwise_map]
  refine (((orderedIndexList_pairwise s F).and (orderedIndexList_nodup s F)).imp ?_)
  rintro ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ ⟨hle, hne⟩
  rw [recordOf_key_of_valid F hi, recordOf_key_of_valid F hj]
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle ?_
  intro hEq
  exact hne (Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val
    (validIndex_eq_of_directionKey_eq s F ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ hEq)))

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.fullTrace_eq_map_orderedIndexList
statement:
theorem fullTrace_eq_map_orderedIndexList
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    fullTrace s F = (orderedIndexList s F).map fun i => recordOf s F i.1
proof:
:= by
  refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise (le := fun x y => x.key < y.key)
    (fun a b _ _ h₁ h₂ => absurd h₂ (asymm h₁))
    (fullTrace_pairwise_key_lt F) (orderedIndexList_map_pairwise_key_lt F) ?_
  refine (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup (fullTrace_nodup F) ?_).mpr ?_
  · exact (orderedIndexList_map_pairwise_key_lt F).imp
      fun hxy hEq => absurd (congrArg IncidentRecord.key hEq) (ne_of_lt hxy)
  · intro r
    rw [mem_fullTrace, List.mem_map]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, mem_orderedIndexList s F ⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, -, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i.1, i.2, rfl⟩

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.fullTrace_target_eq_incidentStream
statement:
theorem fullTrace_target_eq_incidentStream (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    (fullTrace s F).map IncidentRecord.target =
      (incidentStream hnpos s F).map (orbitTargetLift hnpos)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullTrace_eq_map_orderedIndexList, incidentStream, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  refine List.map_congr_left ?_
  intro i _
  exact recordOf_target_eq hnpos F i

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.fullTrace_key_eq_incidentStream
statement:
theorem fullTrace_key_eq_incidentStream (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    (fullTrace s F).map IncidentRecord.key =
      (incidentStream hnpos s F).map
        (orbitEdgeKey hnpos ((bResidualInvolution n).orbit s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullTrace_eq_map_orderedIndexList, incidentStream, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  refine List.map_congr_left ?_
  intro i _
  exact (recordOf_key_of_valid F i.2).trans (validIndex_key_eq_orbitEdgeKey hnpos s F i)

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.fullTrace_length_eq
statement:
theorem fullTrace_length_eq (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    (fullTrace s F).length = (incidentStream hnpos s F).length
proof:
:= by
  simpa using congrArg List.length (fullTrace_target_eq_incidentStream hnpos F)

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.fullTrace_getElem_target
statement:
theorem fullTrace_getElem_target (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k < (fullTrace s F).length) :
    ((fullTrace s F)[k]'hk).target =
      orbitTargetLift hnpos ((incidentStream hnpos s F)[k]'(by
        rw [← fullTrace_length_eq hnpos F]; exact hk))
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : k < (incidentStream hnpos s F).length := by
    rw [← fullTrace_length_eq hnpos F]; exact hk
  have h := congrArg (fun l : List Triple => l[k]?)
    (fullTrace_target_eq_incidentStream hnpos F)
  simp only [List.getElem?_map] at h
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk'] at h
  simpa using h

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.fullTrace_getElem_key
statement:
theorem fullTrace_getElem_key (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k < (fullTrace s F).length) :
    ((fullTrace s F)[k]'hk).key =
      orbitEdgeKey hnpos ((bResidualInvolution n).orbit s)
        ((incidentStream hnpos s F)[k]'(by
          rw [← fullTrace_length_eq hnpos F]; exact hk))
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : k < (incidentStream hnpos s F).length := by
    rw [← fullTrace_length_eq hnpos F]; exact hk
  have h := congrArg (fun l : List DirectionKey => l[k]?)
    (fullTrace_key_eq_incidentStream hnpos F)
  simp only [List.getElem?_map] at h
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk'] at h
  simpa using h

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.fullTrace_exactly_once
statement:
theorem fullTrace_exactly_once (hn : Odd n) (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (tOrbit : (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit) :
    ∃! k : Fin (fullTrace s F).length,
      ((fullTrace s F).get k).target = orbitTargetLift hnpos tOrbit
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := fullTrace_length_eq hnpos F
  obtain ⟨k, hk, huniq⟩ := incidentStream_exactly_once hn hnpos s F tOrbit
  refine ⟨⟨k.1, by omega⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [List.get_eq_getElem]
    rw [fullTrace_getElem_target hnpos F]
    exact congrArg _ hk
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩ hjeq
    simp only [List.get_eq_getElem] at hjeq
    rw [fullTrace_getElem_target hnpos F] at hjeq
    have hjt : (incidentStream hnpos s F).get ⟨j, by omega⟩ = tOrbit :=
      orbitTargetLift_injective hnpos hjeq
    have h2 : j = (k : ℕ) := congrArg Fin.val (huniq ⟨j, by omega⟩ hjt)
    exact Fin.ext h2

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.advance_step
statement:
theorem advance_step (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (st : GenState) :
    (∀ r st', advance s F st = some (r, st') →
        remainingTrace s F st = r :: remainingTrace s F st') ∧
      (advance s F st = none → remainingTrace s F st = [])
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ st : GenState, (hMax n + 1 - st.nextBlock).toNat = k →
      (∀ r st', advance s F st = some (r, st') →
          remainingTrace s F st = r :: remainingTrace s F st') ∧
        (advance s F st = none → remainingTrace s F st = []) from H _ st rfl
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro st hk
      obtain ⟨h, pending⟩ := st
      dsimp only at hk
      have hgt : ¬ h ≤ hMax n := by omega
      cases pending with
      | cons r rest =>
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · intro r' st' heq
            rw [advance] at heq
            simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
            obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := heq
            simp [remainingTrace]
          · intro hnone
            rw [advance] at hnone
            simp at hnone
      | nil =>
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · intro r' st' heq
            rw [advance, if_neg hgt] at heq
            simp at heq
          · intro _
            simp only [remainingTrace, List.nil_append]
            rw [blocksFrom, if_neg hgt]
  | succ k ih =>
      intro st hk
      obtain ⟨h, pending⟩ := st
      dsimp only at hk
      cases pending with
      | cons r rest =>
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · intro r' st' heq
            rw [advance] at heq
            simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
            obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := heq
            simp [remainingTrace]
          · intro hnone
            rw [advance] at hnone
            simp at hnone
      | nil =>
          have hle : h ≤ hMax n := by omega
          have hadv : advance s F ⟨h, []⟩ =
              advance s F ⟨h + 1, blockRecords s F h⟩ := by
            rw [advance, if_pos hle]
          have hrem : remainingTrace s F ⟨h, []⟩ =
              remainingTrace s F ⟨h + 1, blockRecords s F h⟩ := by
            simp only [remainingTrace, List.nil_append]
            rw [blocksFrom, if_pos hle]
          have hih := ih ⟨h + 1, blockRecords s F h⟩ (by dsimp only; omega)
          rw [hadv, hrem]
          exact hih

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.advance_cons
statement:
theorem advance_cons (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) (h : ℤ)
    (r : IncidentRecord) (rest : List IncidentRecord) :
    advance s F ⟨h, r :: rest⟩ = some (r, ⟨h, rest⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [advance]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.advance_nil_of_le
statement:
theorem advance_nil_of_le (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {h : ℤ} (hle : h ≤ hMax n) :
    advance s F ⟨h, []⟩ = advance s F ⟨h + 1, blockRecords s F h⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [advance, if_pos hle]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.advance_nil_of_gt
statement:
theorem advance_nil_of_gt (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {h : ℤ} (hgt : ¬ h ≤ hMax n) : advance s F ⟨h, []⟩ = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [advance, if_neg hgt]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.advance_dispose_empty_block
statement:
theorem advance_dispose_empty_block (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {h : ℤ} (hle : h ≤ hMax n) (hb : blockRecords s F h = []) :
    advance s F ⟨h, []⟩ = advance s F ⟨h + 1, []⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [advance_nil_of_le F hle, hb]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.advance_eq_some
statement:
theorem advance_eq_some (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {st : GenState} {r : IncidentRecord} {st' : GenState}
    (h : advance s F st = some (r, st')) :
    remainingTrace s F st = r :: remainingTrace s F st'
proof:
:=
  (advance_step F st).1 r st' h

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.advance_eq_none
statement:
theorem advance_eq_none (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {st : GenState} (h : advance s F st = none) :
    remainingTrace s F st = []
proof:
:=
  (advance_step F st).2 h

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.advance_length_lt
statement:
theorem advance_length_lt (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {st : GenState} {r : IncidentRecord} {st' : GenState}
    (h : advance s F st = some (r, st')) :
    (remainingTrace s F st').length < (remainingTrace s F st).length
proof:
:= by
  rw [advance_eq_some F h]
  simp

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.drain_eq_remainingTrace
statement:
theorem drain_eq_remainingTrace (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    (st : GenState) : drain s F st = remainingTrace s F st
proof:
:= by
  induction st using drain.induct (s := s) (F := F) with
  | case1 st hst => rw [drain, hst, advance_eq_none F hst]
  | case2 st r st' hst ih =>
      rw [drain, hst]
      dsimp only
      rw [ih, advance_eq_some F hst]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.drain_initial
statement:
theorem drain_initial (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    drain s F GenState.initial = fullTrace s F
proof:
:= by
  rw [drain_eq_remainingTrace, remainingTrace_initial]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.oneBlock_initial
statement:
theorem oneBlock_initial (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    OneBlock s F GenState.initial
proof:
:= by
  simp [OneBlock, GenState.initial]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.oneBlock_advance
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ st : GenState, (hMax n + 1 - st.nextBlock).toNat = k →
      OneBlock s F st → ∀ r st', advance s F st = some (r, st') → OneBlock s F st'
    from H _ st rfl hst r st' h
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro st hk hinv r st' heq
      obtain ⟨hh, pending⟩ := st
      dsimp only at hk
      have hgt : ¬ hh ≤ hMax n := by omega
      cases pending with
      | cons a rest =>
          rw [advance] at heq
          simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := heq
          exact List.IsSuffix.trans (List.suffix_cons _ _) hinv
      | nil =>
          rw [advance, if_neg hgt] at heq
          simp at heq
  | succ k ih =>
      intro st hk hinv r st' heq
      obtain ⟨hh, pending⟩ := st
      dsimp only at hk
      cases pending with
      | cons a rest =>
          rw [advance] at heq
          simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := heq
          exact List.IsSuffix.trans (List.suffix_cons _ _) hinv
      | nil =>
          have hle : hh ≤ hMax n := by omega
          rw [advance, if_pos hle] at heq
          refine ih ⟨hh + 1, blockRecords s F hh⟩ (by dsimp only; omega) ?_ r st' heq
          show blockRecords s F hh <:+ blockRecords s F (hh + 1 - 1)
          rw [show hh + 1 - 1 = hh by ring]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.oneBlock_storage_bound
statement:
theorem oneBlock_storage_bound (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s)))
    {st : GenState} (hst : OneBlock s F st) :
    st.pending.length ≤ (blockIndexList n F (st.nextBlock - 1)).length
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (List.IsSuffix.length_le hst) ?_
  rw [blockRecords, List.length_mergeSort]
  exact List.length_filterMap_le _ _

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signAct_one
statement: @[simp] theorem signAct_one (x : X) : I.signAct 1 x = x
proof: := by simp [signAct]

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signAct_neg_one
statement: @[simp] theorem signAct_neg_one (x : X) : I.signAct (-1) x = I.neg x
proof:
:= by
  simp [signAct]

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signAct_neg
statement:
theorem signAct_neg (σ : ℤ) (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (x : X) :
    I.signAct σ (I.neg x) = I.signAct (-σ) x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> simp [I.neg_neg]

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signAct_mul
statement:
theorem signAct_mul (σ τ : ℤ) (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (hτ : τ = 1 ∨ τ = -1)
    (x : X) : I.signAct σ (I.signAct τ x) = I.signAct (σ * τ) x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hτ with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [I.neg_neg]

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signAct_neg_sign
statement:
theorem signAct_neg_sign {σ : ℤ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (x : X) :
    I.signAct (-σ) x = I.neg (I.signAct σ x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> simp [I.neg_neg]

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.orbit_signAct
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbit_signAct (σ : ℤ) (x : X) :
    I.orbit (I.signAct σ x) = I.orbit x
proof:
:= by
  unfold signAct
  split
  · rfl
  · exact I.orbit_neg x

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signAct_inj_sign
statement:
theorem signAct_inj_sign {σ τ : ℤ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (hτ : τ = 1 ∨ τ = -1)
    {x : X} (h : I.signAct σ x = I.signAct τ x) : σ = τ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hτ with rfl | rfl
  · rfl
  · rw [signAct_one, signAct_neg_one] at h
    exact absurd h.symm (I.no_fixed x)
  · rw [signAct_one, signAct_neg_one] at h
    exact absurd h (I.no_fixed x)
  · rfl

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signOf_mem
statement:
theorem signOf_mem (key : X → K) (x : X) :
    I.signOf key x = 1 ∨ I.signOf key x = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold signOf; split
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr rfl

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signAct_signOf_canonicalPoint
statement:
theorem signAct_signOf_canonicalPoint (key : X → K) (x : X) :
    I.signAct (I.signOf key x) (I.canonicalPoint key x) = x
proof:
:= by
  unfold signOf canonicalPoint
  by_cases h : key x < key (I.neg x)
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h, I.neg_neg]

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signAct_signOf_canonicalRepresentative
statement:
theorem signAct_signOf_canonicalRepresentative (key : X → K)
    (hkey : Function.Injective key) (x : X) :
    I.signAct (I.signOf key x)
      (I.canonicalRepresentative key hkey (I.orbit x)) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalRepresentative_orbit]
  exact I.signAct_signOf_canonicalPoint key x

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.exists_unique_sign
statement:
theorem exists_unique_sign (key : X → K) (hkey : Function.Injective key)
    (x : X) :
    ∃! σ : ℤ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧
      I.signAct σ (I.canonicalRepresentative key hkey (I.orbit x)) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨I.signOf key x, ⟨I.signOf_mem key x, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [canonicalRepresentative_orbit]
    exact I.signAct_signOf_canonicalPoint key x
  · rintro τ ⟨hτ, hτx⟩
    rw [canonicalRepresentative_orbit] at hτx
    refine I.signAct_inj_sign (x := I.canonicalPoint key x) hτ
      (I.signOf_mem key x) ?_
    rw [hτx, I.signAct_signOf_canonicalPoint key x]

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signOf_neg
statement:
theorem signOf_neg (key : X → K) (hkey : Function.Injective key) (x : X) :
    I.signOf key (I.neg x) = - I.signOf key x
proof:
:= by
  have hne : key x ≠ key (I.neg x) := fun h => I.no_fixed x (hkey h).symm
  unfold signOf
  rw [I.neg_neg]
  by_cases h : key x < key (I.neg x)
  · rw [if_neg (not_lt_of_gt h), if_pos h]
  · have h' : key (I.neg x) < key x := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h) hne.symm
    rw [if_pos h', if_neg h]; norm_num

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signOf_canonicalPoint
statement:
theorem signOf_canonicalPoint (key : X → K) (hkey : Function.Injective key)
    (x : X) : I.signOf key (I.canonicalPoint key x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonicalPoint
  by_cases h : key x < key (I.neg x)
  · rw [if_pos h]
    simp [signOf, h]
  · have hne : key x ≠ key (I.neg x) := fun hc => I.no_fixed x (hkey hc).symm
    have h' : key (I.neg x) < key x := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h) hne.symm
    rw [if_neg h]
    simp [signOf, I.neg_neg, h']

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signOf_canonicalRepresentative
statement:
@[simp] theorem signOf_canonicalRepresentative (key : X → K)
    (hkey : Function.Injective key) (q : I.Orbit) :
    I.signOf key (I.canonicalRepresentative key hkey q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | _ x => exact I.signOf_canonicalPoint key hkey x

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.signOf_signAct
statement:
theorem signOf_signAct (key : X → K) (hkey : Function.Injective key)
    {σ : ℤ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (q : I.Orbit) :
    I.signOf key (I.signAct σ (I.canonicalRepresentative key hkey q)) = σ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl
  · simp [I.signOf_canonicalRepresentative key hkey q]
  · rw [signAct_neg_one, I.signOf_neg key hkey, I.signOf_canonicalRepresentative]

name: TunnellMap.signActB_one
statement: @[simp] theorem signActB_one (x : BResidual n) : signActB 1 x = x
proof:
:=
  (bResidualInvolution n).signAct_one x

name: TunnellMap.signActB_neg_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem signActB_neg_one (x : BResidual n) :
    signActB (-1) x = negBResidual x
proof:
:=
  (bResidualInvolution n).signAct_neg_one x

name: TunnellMap.signActA_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem signActA_one {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) (y : AResidual n) :
    signActA hnpos 1 y = y
proof:
:=
  (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).signAct_one y

name: TunnellMap.signActA_neg_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem signActA_neg_one {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) (y : AResidual n) :
    signActA hnpos (-1) y = negAResidual y
proof:
:=
  (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).signAct_neg_one y

name: TunnellMap.orbit_canonicalBResidualRepresentative
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbit_canonicalBResidualRepresentative
    (q : (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit) :
    (bResidualInvolution n).orbit (canonicalBResidualRepresentative q) = q
proof:
:=
  (bResidualInvolution n).orbit_canonicalRepresentative bResidualLexKey
    bResidualLexKey_injective q

name: TunnellMap.orbit_canonicalAResidualRepresentative
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbit_canonicalAResidualRepresentative {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (o : (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit) :
    (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit
      (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos o) = o
proof:
:=
  (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit_canonicalRepresentative aResidualLexKey
    aResidualLexKey_injective o

name: TunnellMap.signActB_neg_sign
statement:
theorem signActB_neg_sign {σ : ℤ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (x : BResidual n) :
    signActB (-σ) x = negBResidual (signActB σ x)
proof:
:=
  (bResidualInvolution n).signAct_neg_sign hσ x

name: TunnellMap.signActA_neg_sign
proof:
:=
  (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).signAct_neg_sign hσ y

name: TunnellMap.bResidualSign_mem
statement:
theorem bResidualSign_mem (x : BResidual n) :
    bResidualSign x = 1 ∨ bResidualSign x = -1
proof:
:=
  (bResidualInvolution n).signOf_mem _ x

name: TunnellMap.aResidualSign_mem
statement:
theorem aResidualSign_mem {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) (y : AResidual n) :
    aResidualSign hnpos y = 1 ∨ aResidualSign hnpos y = -1
proof:
:=
  (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).signOf_mem _ y

name: TunnellMap.bResidual_exists_unique_sign
statement:
theorem bResidual_exists_unique_sign (x : BResidual n) :
    ∃! σ : ℤ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧
      signActB σ
        (canonicalBResidualRepresentative ((bResidualInvolution n).orbit x)) = x
proof:
:=
  (bResidualInvolution n).exists_unique_sign bResidualLexKey
    bResidualLexKey_injective x

name: TunnellMap.aResidual_exists_unique_sign
statement:
theorem aResidual_exists_unique_sign {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) (y : AResidual n) :
    ∃! σ : ℤ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧
      signActA hnpos σ
        (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
          ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit y)) = y
proof:
:=
  (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).exists_unique_sign aResidualLexKey
    aResidualLexKey_injective y

name: TunnellMap.bResidual_decomposition
statement:
theorem bResidual_decomposition (x : BResidual n) :
    signActB (bResidualSign x)
        (canonicalBResidualRepresentative ((bResidualInvolution n).orbit x)) = x
proof:
:=
  (bResidualInvolution n).signAct_signOf_canonicalRepresentative bResidualLexKey
    bResidualLexKey_injective x

name: TunnellMap.aResidual_decomposition
statement:
theorem aResidual_decomposition {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) (y : AResidual n) :
    signActA hnpos (aResidualSign hnpos y)
        (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
          ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit y)) = y
proof:
:=
  (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).signAct_signOf_canonicalRepresentative
    aResidualLexKey aResidualLexKey_injective y

name: TunnellMap.bResidualSign_signAct
statement:
theorem bResidualSign_signAct {σ : ℤ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1)
    (q : (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit) :
    bResidualSign (signActB σ (canonicalBResidualRepresentative q)) = σ
proof:
:=
  (bResidualInvolution n).signOf_signAct bResidualLexKey
    bResidualLexKey_injective hσ q

name: TunnellMap.aResidualSign_signAct
statement:
theorem aResidualSign_signAct {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) {σ : ℤ}
    (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (o : (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit) :
    aResidualSign hnpos
        (signActA hnpos σ (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos o)) = σ
proof:
:=
  (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).signOf_signAct aResidualLexKey
    aResidualLexKey_injective hσ o

name: TunnellMap.orbit_signActB
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbit_signActB (σ : ℤ) (x : BResidual n) :
    (bResidualInvolution n).orbit (signActB σ x) =
      (bResidualInvolution n).orbit x
proof:
:=
  (bResidualInvolution n).orbit_signAct σ x

name: TunnellMap.orbit_signActA
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbit_signActA {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) (σ : ℤ) (y : AResidual n) :
    (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit (signActA hnpos σ y) =
      (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit y
proof:
:=
  (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit_signAct σ y

name: TunnellMap.vsmul_one
statement: theorem vsmul_one (v : Triple) : vsmul 1 v = v
proof:
:= by
  apply Triple.ext <;> simp [vsmul]

name: TunnellMap.vsmul_neg_one
statement: theorem vsmul_neg_one (v : Triple) : vsmul (-1) v = negTriple v
proof:
:= by
  apply Triple.ext <;> simp [vsmul, negTriple]

name: TunnellMap.residualTarget_decomposition
statement:
theorem residualTarget_decomposition {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) (y : AResidual n) :
    signActA hnpos (targetLiftSign (residualTargetLift y))
        (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
          ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit y)) = y
proof:
:= by
  have hspec : residualTargetLift y =
      vsmul (targetLiftSign (residualTargetLift y))
        (canonicalTargetLift (residualTargetLift y)) :=
    canonicalTargetLift_spec _
  have hcanon : canonicalTargetLift (residualTargetLift y) =
      residualTargetLift (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
        ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit y)) :=
    canonicalTargetLift_eq hnpos y
  apply residualTargetLift_injective
  rcases targetLiftSign_mem (residualTargetLift y) with hm | hm
  · rw [hm, signActA_one]
    conv_rhs => rw [hspec, hm, hcanon, vsmul_one]
  · rw [hm, signActA_neg_one, ← negTriple_residualTargetLift]
    conv_rhs => rw [hspec, hm, hcanon, vsmul_neg_one]

name: TunnellMap.targetLiftSign_eq_aResidualSign
statement:
theorem targetLiftSign_eq_aResidualSign {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (y : AResidual n) :
    targetLiftSign (residualTargetLift y) = aResidualSign hnpos y
proof:
:= by
  refine (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).signAct_inj_sign
    (x := canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
      ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit y))
    (targetLiftSign_mem _) (aResidualSign_mem hnpos y) ?_
  show signActA hnpos (targetLiftSign (residualTargetLift y))
      (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
        ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit y)) =
    signActA hnpos (aResidualSign hnpos y)
      (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
        ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit y))
  rw [residualTarget_decomposition hnpos y, aResidual_decomposition hnpos y]

name: TunnellMap.etaPointExec_eq
statement:
theorem etaPointExec_eq {n : ℤ} (s : BResidual n) (t : AResidual n) :
    etaPointExec s t = etaPoint s t
proof:
:= by
  unfold etaPointExec etaPoint
  rw [directionKeyExec_eq (plusVector_ne_zero s t),
    directionKeyExec_eq (minusVector_ne_zero s t)]
  by_cases h : directionKey (plusVector s t) < directionKey (minusVector s t) <;>
    simp [h]

name: TunnellMap.etaPoint_mem
statement:
theorem etaPoint_mem {n : ℤ} (s : BResidual n) (t : AResidual n) :
    etaPoint s t = 1 ∨ etaPoint s t = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold etaPoint; split
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr rfl

name: TunnellMap.etaPoint_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem etaPoint_eq_one_iff {n : ℤ} (s : BResidual n) (t : AResidual n) :
    etaPoint s t = 1 ↔
      directionKey (plusVector s t) < directionKey (minusVector s t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold etaPoint
  by_cases h : directionKey (plusVector s t) < directionKey (minusVector s t) <;>
    simp [h]

name: TunnellMap.etaPoint_neg_target
statement:
theorem etaPoint_neg_target {n : ℤ} (s : BResidual n) (t : AResidual n) :
    etaPoint s (negAResidual t) = - etaPoint s t
proof:
:= by
  unfold etaPoint
  rw [plusVector_neg_target, minusVector_neg_target]
  by_cases h : directionKey (plusVector s t) < directionKey (minusVector s t)
  · rw [if_neg (not_lt_of_gt h), if_pos h]
  · have h' : directionKey (minusVector s t) < directionKey (plusVector s t) :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h) (Ne.symm (plus_minus_keys_ne s t))
    rw [if_pos h', if_neg h]
    norm_num

name: TunnellMap.etaPoint_neg_source
statement:
theorem etaPoint_neg_source {n : ℤ} (s : BResidual n) (t : AResidual n) :
    etaPoint (negBResidual s) t = - etaPoint s t
proof:
:= by
  unfold etaPoint
  rw [plusVector_neg_source, minusVector_neg_source,
    directionKey_negTriple (minusVector_ne_zero s t),
    directionKey_negTriple (plusVector_ne_zero s t)]
  by_cases h : directionKey (plusVector s t) < directionKey (minusVector s t)
  · rw [if_neg (not_lt_of_gt h), if_pos h]
  · have h' : directionKey (minusVector s t) < directionKey (plusVector s t) :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h) (Ne.symm (plus_minus_keys_ne s t))
    rw [if_pos h', if_neg h]
    norm_num

name: TunnellMap.etaPoint_signActB
statement:
theorem etaPoint_signActB {n : ℤ} {σ : ℤ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1)
    (s : BResidual n) (t : AResidual n) :
    etaPoint (signActB σ s) t = σ * etaPoint s t
proof:
:= by
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl
  · simp
  · rw [signActB_neg_one, etaPoint_neg_source]; ring

name: TunnellMap.etaPoint_signActA
statement:
theorem etaPoint_signActA {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) {σ : ℤ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1)
    (s : BResidual n) (t : AResidual n) :
    etaPoint s (signActA hnpos σ t) = σ * etaPoint s t
proof:
:= by
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl
  · simp
  · rw [signActA_neg_one, etaPoint_neg_target]; ring

name: TunnellMap.canonicalEta_mem
statement:
theorem canonicalEta_mem {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (q : (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit)
    (o : (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit) :
    canonicalEta hnpos q o = 1 ∨ canonicalEta hnpos q o = -1
proof:
:=
  etaPoint_mem _ _

name: TunnellMap.canonicalEta_mul_self
statement:
theorem canonicalEta_mul_self {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (q : (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit)
    (o : (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit) :
    canonicalEta hnpos q o * canonicalEta hnpos q o = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases canonicalEta_mem hnpos q o with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> ring

name: TunnellMap.signedPartner_eq_preferredTarget
statement:
theorem signedPartner_eq_preferredTarget {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (s : BResidual n) (t : AResidual n) :
    signedPartner hnpos s t = preferredTarget s t
proof:
:= by
  unfold signedPartner preferredTarget etaPoint
  by_cases h : directionKey (plusVector s t) < directionKey (minusVector s t) <;>
    simp [h]
  rfl

name: TunnellMap.signedPartner_neg_target
statement:
theorem signedPartner_neg_target {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n) (s : BResidual n)
    (t : AResidual n) :
    signedPartner hnpos s (negAResidual t) = signedPartner hnpos s t
proof:
:= by
  unfold signedPartner
  rw [etaPoint_neg_target]
  rcases etaPoint_mem s t with h | h <;> rw [h]
  · rw [signActA_neg_one, signActA_one, negAResidual_neg]
  · rw [show - (-1 : ℤ) = 1 by norm_num, signActA_one, signActA_neg_one]

name: TunnellMap.signedPartner_signActA
proof:
:= by
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl
  · rw [signActA_one]
  · rw [signActA_neg_one]
    exact signedPartner_neg_target hnpos s t

name: TunnellMap.canonicalResidualMapOf_signAct
statement:
theorem canonicalResidualMapOf_signAct {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (M : (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit ≃ (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit)
    (q : (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit) {σ : ℤ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) :
    canonicalResidualMapOf hnpos M
        (signActB σ (canonicalBResidualRepresentative q)) =
      signActA hnpos (σ * canonicalEta hnpos q (M q))
        (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos (M q))
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonicalResidualMapOf
  rw [orbit_signActB, orbit_canonicalBResidualRepresentative,
    bResidualSign_signAct hσ]

name: TunnellMap.canonicalResidualMapOf_eq_signedPartner
statement:
theorem canonicalResidualMapOf_eq_signedPartner {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (M : (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit ≃ (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit)
    (x : BResidual n) :
    canonicalResidualMapOf hnpos M x =
      signedPartner hnpos x
        (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
          (M ((bResidualInvolution n).orbit x)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, (bResidualInvolution n).orbit x = q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσ : bResidualSign x = 1 ∨ bResidualSign x = -1 := bResidualSign_mem x
  have hx : signActB (bResidualSign x) (canonicalBResidualRepresentative q) = x := by
    rw [← hq]; exact bResidual_decomposition x
  have hkey : etaPoint x
      (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos (M q)) =
      bResidualSign x *
        etaPoint (canonicalBResidualRepresentative q)
          (canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos (M q)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hx]
    rw [etaPoint_signActB hσ]
  unfold canonicalResidualMapOf signedPartner canonicalEta
  rw [hq, hkey]

name: TunnellMap.FreeInvolution.liftOrbitEquiv_neg_representative
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [liftOrbitEquiv, orbitBoolEquiv, signedOrbitProductEquiv, I.orbit_neg,
    I.orbit_representative, I.no_fixed]

name: TunnellMap.residualEquivOfOrbitCard_neg_representative
statement:
theorem residualEquivOfOrbitCard_neg_representative
    (hcard : Fintype.card (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit =
      Fintype.card (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit)
    (q : (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit) :
    residualEquivOfOrbitCard hnpos hcard
        (negBResidual ((bResidualInvolution n).representative q)) =
      negAResidual
        (preferredTarget ((bResidualInvolution n).representative q)
          ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).representative
            (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard q)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  show (bResidualInvolution n).liftOrbitEquiv (aResidualInvolution n hnpos)
      (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard)
      (fun s => orbitSignEquiv hnpos s (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard s))
      ((bResidualInvolution n).neg
        ((bResidualInvolution n).representative q)) = _
  rw [FreeInvolution.liftOrbitEquiv_neg_representative]
  unfold orbitSignEquiv
  by_cases hlt : directionKey
      (plusVector ((bResidualInvolution n).representative q)
        ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).representative
          (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard q))) <
      directionKey
      (minusVector ((bResidualInvolution n).representative q)
        ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).representative
          (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard q)))
  · rw [if_pos hlt]
    simp only [Equiv.refl_apply]
    rw [show preferredTarget ((bResidualInvolution n).representative q)
        ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).representative
          (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard q)) =
        (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).representative
          (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard q) by
      unfold preferredTarget; rw [if_pos hlt]]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg hlt]
    simp only [boolFlipEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Bool.not_true,
      if_neg (by simp : ¬ (false = true))]
    rw [show preferredTarget ((bResidualInvolution n).representative q)
        ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).representative
          (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard q)) =
        negAResidual ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).representative
          (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard q)) by
      unfold preferredTarget; rw [if_neg hlt]]
    rw [negAResidual_neg]

name: TunnellMap.residualEquivOfOrbitCard_apply
statement:
theorem residualEquivOfOrbitCard_apply
    (hcard : Fintype.card (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit =
      Fintype.card (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit) (x : BResidual n) :
    residualEquivOfOrbitCard hnpos hcard x =
      signedPartner hnpos x
        ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).representative
          (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard
            ((bResidualInvolution n).orbit x)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, (bResidualInvolution n).orbit x = q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hrel : x = (bResidualInvolution n).representative q ∨
      x = negBResidual ((bResidualInvolution n).representative q) :=
    (bResidualInvolution n).orbit_eq_iff.mp
      (((bResidualInvolution n).orbit_representative q).trans hq.symm)
  rw [hq]
  rcases hrel with hx | hx
  · rw [hx, residualEquivOfOrbitCard_representative hnpos hcard q,
      signedPartner_eq_preferredTarget]
  · rw [hx, residualEquivOfOrbitCard_neg_representative hnpos hcard q,
      ← signedPartner_eq_preferredTarget hnpos]
    unfold signedPartner
    rw [etaPoint_neg_source, signActA_neg_sign hnpos (etaPoint_mem _ _)]

name: TunnellMap.canonicalResidualMapOf_eq_residualEquivOfOrbitCard
statement:
theorem canonicalResidualMapOf_eq_residualEquivOfOrbitCard
    (hcard : Fintype.card (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit =
      Fintype.card (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit) (x : BResidual n) :
    canonicalResidualMapOf hnpos (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard) x =
      residualEquivOfOrbitCard hnpos hcard x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [canonicalResidualMapOf_eq_signedPartner, residualEquivOfOrbitCard_apply]
  obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ : ∃ o, residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard
      ((bResidualInvolution n).orbit x) = o := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [ho]
  have hdec := aResidual_decomposition hnpos
    ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).representative o)
  rw [(aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit_representative o] at hdec
  rw [← hdec, signedPartner_signActA hnpos (aResidualSign_mem hnpos _)]
