    t1, t2, t3, t4]

name: TunnellMap.Examples41.residual_inverse_sign_example
statement:
theorem residual_inverse_sign_example :
    negTriple (residualTargetLift t2) = ⟨4, -3, 0⟩ ∧
      negTriple (negTriple (residualSourceLift s2)) = residualSourceLift s2 ∧
      s2.1.1 = ⟨-2, -5, 1⟩
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [t2, s2, midpointSource, residualTargetLift, residualSourceLift,
    aLift, bLift, negTriple]

name: TunnellMap.Examples41.sharpness_three_sources
statement:
theorem sharpness_three_sources :
    (sharpRanking 3).proposalCount (sharpMatching 3) (0 : Fin 3) = 1 ∧
      (sharpRanking 3).proposalCount (sharpMatching 3) (1 : Fin 3) = 2 ∧
      (sharpRanking 3).proposalCount (sharpMatching 3) (2 : Fin 3) = 3 ∧
      (∑ i : Fin 3, (sharpRanking 3).proposalCount (sharpMatching 3) i) = 6
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa using sharpProposalCount 3 (0 : Fin 3)
  · constructor
    · simpa using sharpProposalCount 3 (1 : Fin 3)
    · constructor
      · simpa using sharpProposalCount 3 (2 : Fin 3)
      · norm_num [sharpProposalCount_total]

name: TunnellMap.mem_intIccL
statement: theorem mem_intIccL {lo hi x : ℤ} : x ∈ intIccL lo hi ↔ lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  unfold intIccL
  by_cases h : lo ≤ hi
  · rw [if_pos h]
    simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩; omega
    · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
      exact ⟨(x - lo).toNat, by omega, by omega⟩
  · rw [if_neg h]
    simp only [List.not_mem_nil, false_iff]
    omega

name: TunnellMap.intIccL_pairwise_lt
statement: theorem intIccL_pairwise_lt (lo hi : ℤ) : (intIccL lo hi).Pairwise (· < ·)
proof:
:= by
  unfold intIccL
  by_cases h : lo ≤ hi
  · rw [if_pos h]
    rw [List.pairwise_map]
    exact List.Pairwise.imp (fun {a b} (hab : a < b) => by omega)
      (List.pairwise_lt_range (n := (hi - lo).toNat + 1))
  · rw [if_neg h]; exact List.Pairwise.nil

name: TunnellMap.intIcc_sort_eq
statement: theorem intIcc_sort_eq (lo hi : ℤ) : (intIcc lo hi).sort (· ≤ ·) = intIccL lo hi
proof:
:=
  Finset.sort_eq_of_sorted_lt _ _ (intIccL_pairwise_lt lo hi) fun x => by
    rw [mem_intIccL, mem_intIcc]

name: TunnellMap.qValues_sort_eq
statement:
theorem qValues_sort_eq (n A : ℤ) :
    (qValues n A).sort (· ≤ ·) = qValuesL n A
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sort_eq_of_sorted_lt _ _ ?_ ?_
  · exact List.Pairwise.filter _ (intIccL_pairwise_lt _ _)
  · intro x
    simp only [qValuesL, List.mem_filter, mem_intIccL, decide_eq_true_eq, qValues,
      Finset.mem_filter, mem_intIcc]

name: TunnellMap.bLowerK_eq
statement:
theorem bLowerK_eq {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) {p : Triple} (F : OrthogonalFrame p)
    (A q : ℤ) : bLowerK n F A q = bLower n F A q
proof:
:= by
  rw [bLowerK, bLower, ceil_intCast_div_intCast _ _ hn, isqrtK_eq]

name: TunnellMap.bUpperK_eq
statement:
theorem bUpperK_eq {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) {p : Triple} (F : OrthogonalFrame p)
    (A q : ℤ) : bUpperK n F A q = bUpper n F A q
proof:
:= by
  rw [bUpperK, bUpper, floor_intCast_div_intCast _ _ hn, isqrtK_eq]

name: TunnellMap.bValues_sort_eq
statement:
theorem bValues_sort_eq {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) {p : Triple} (F : OrthogonalFrame p)
    (A q : ℤ) : (bValues n F A q).sort (· ≤ ·) = bValuesL n F A q
proof:
:= by
  rw [bValues, intIcc_sort_eq, bValuesL, bLowerK_eq hn, bUpperK_eq hn]

name: TunnellMap.rootValues_sort_eq
statement:
theorem rootValues_sort_eq {p : Triple} (F : OrthogonalFrame p) (A q b : ℤ) :
    (rootValues F A q b).sort (· ≤ ·) = rootValuesL F A q b
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ Int.sqrt (F.halfDiscriminant A q b) := Int.sqrt_nonneg _
  refine Finset.sort_eq_of_sorted_lt _ _ ?_ ?_
  · refine List.Pairwise.filter _ ?_
    simp only [isqrtK_eq]
    by_cases h : Int.sqrt (F.halfDiscriminant A q b) = 0
    · rw [if_pos h]; exact List.pairwise_singleton _ _
    · rw [if_neg h]
      refine List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨?_, List.pairwise_singleton _ _⟩
      intro y hy
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hy
      omega
  · intro x
    simp only [rootValuesL, isqrtK_eq, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq,
      mem_rootValues]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hmem, hcond⟩
      refine ⟨?_, hcond.1, ?_⟩
      · by_cases h : Int.sqrt (F.halfDiscriminant A q b) = 0
        · rw [if_pos h] at hmem
          rw [List.mem_singleton] at hmem
          exact Or.inl (by omega)
        · rw [if_neg h] at hmem
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h' | h'
          · exact Or.inr h'
          · exact Or.inl (List.mem_singleton.mp h')
      · simpa using hcond.2
    · rintro ⟨hmem, hsq, hdvd⟩
      refine ⟨?_, hsq, by simpa using hdvd⟩
      by_cases h : Int.sqrt (F.halfDiscriminant A q b) = 0
      · rw [if_pos h]
        rcases hmem with h' | h' <;> (rw [List.mem_singleton]; omega)
      · rw [if_neg h]
        rcases hmem with h' | h'
        · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr (List.mem_singleton.mpr h'))
        · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl h')

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockIndexListK_eq
statement:
theorem blockIndexListK_eq (hn : 0 ≤ n) (F : OrthogonalFrame p) (h : ℤ) :
    blockIndexListK n F h = blockIndexList n F h
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockIndexListK, blockIndexList, qValues_sort_eq]
  refine List.flatMap_congr fun q _ => ?_
  rw [bValues_sort_eq hn]
  refine List.flatMap_congr fun b _ => ?_
  rw [rootValues_sort_eq]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blockRecordsK_eq
statement:
theorem blockRecordsK_eq (hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) {h : ℤ}
    (h1 : 1 ≤ h) (h2 : h ≤ hMax n) :
    blockRecordsK s F h = blockRecords s F h
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockRecordsK, blockIndexListK_eq hn, blockRecords,
    mergeSort_eq_isortB recordLe (fun a b => by
        simpa using recordLe_total a b)
      (fun a b c => recordLe_trans a b c) ?_]
  intro a ha b hb hab hba
  have hperm : ((blockIndexList n F h).filterMap (emit s F)).Perm
      (blockRecords s F h) := (List.mergeSort_perm _ _).symm
  have hne := blockRecords_pairwise_key_ne (s := s) F h1 h2
  have ha' : a ∈ blockRecords s F h := hperm.mem_iff.mp ha
  have hb' : b ∈ blockRecords s F h := hperm.mem_iff.mp hb
  have hkey : a.key = b.key := by
    simp only [recordLe, keyLeExec_iff] at hab hba
    exact le_antisymm hab hba
  by_contra hab'
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hia⟩ := (mem_blockRecords F h a).mp ha'
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjb⟩ := (mem_blockRecords F h b).mp hb'
  have hij : i = j :=
    recordOf_injOn_valid F (mem_validIndices_of_block F h1 h2 hi.1 hi.2)
      (mem_validIndices_of_block F h1 h2 hj.1 hj.2) (by rw [← hia, ← hjb]; exact hkey)
  exact hab' (by rw [hia, hjb, hij])

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.blocksFromK_eq
statement:
theorem blocksFromK_eq (hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (h : ℤ), 1 ≤ h → (hMax n + 1 - h).toNat ≤ fuel →
      blocksFromK s F fuel h = blocksFrom s F h
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      intro h h1 hfuel
      have hgt : ¬ h ≤ hMax n := by omega
      rw [blocksFromK, blocksFrom, if_neg hgt]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      intro h h1 hfuel
      rw [blocksFromK, blocksFrom]
      by_cases hle : h ≤ hMax n
      · rw [if_pos hle, if_pos hle, blockRecordsK_eq hn F h1 hle,
          ih (h + 1) (by omega) (by omega)]
      · rw [if_neg hle, if_neg hle]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.advanceKAux_eq
statement:
theorem advanceKAux_eq (hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) :
    ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (st : GenState), 1 ≤ st.nextBlock →
      (hMax n + 1 - st.nextBlock).toNat ≤ fuel →
      advanceKAux s F fuel st = advance s F st
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      rintro ⟨h, pend⟩ h1 hfuel
      cases pend with
      | cons r rest => rw [advanceKAux, advance]
      | nil =>
          have h1' : (1 : ℤ) ≤ h := h1
          have hfuel' : (hMax n + 1 - h).toNat ≤ 0 := hfuel
          have hgt : ¬ h ≤ hMax n := by omega
          rw [advanceKAux, advance, if_neg hgt]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      rintro ⟨h, pend⟩ h1 hfuel
      cases pend with
      | cons r rest => rw [advanceKAux, advance]
      | nil =>
          have h1' : (1 : ℤ) ≤ h := h1
          have hfuel' : (hMax n + 1 - h).toNat ≤ fuel + 1 := hfuel
          by_cases hle : h ≤ hMax n
          · rw [advanceKAux, advance, if_pos hle, if_pos hle,
              blockRecordsK_eq hn F h1' hle,
              ih ⟨h + 1, blockRecords s F h⟩
                (show (1 : ℤ) ≤ h + 1 by omega)
                (show (hMax n + 1 - (h + 1)).toNat ≤ fuel by omega)]
          · rw [advanceKAux, advance, if_neg hle, if_neg hle]

name: TunnellMap.BlockGen.advanceK_eq
statement:
theorem advanceK_eq (hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (F : OrthogonalFrame (tau (residualSourceLift s))) (st : GenState)
    (h1 : 1 ≤ st.nextBlock) : advanceK s F st = advance s F st
proof:
:=
  advanceKAux_eq hn F _ st h1 le_rfl

name: TunnellMap.lgReduceAuxK_eq
statement:
theorem lgReduceAuxK_eq :
    ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (u v : Triple), (dot u u).toNat ≤ fuel →
      lgReduceAuxK fuel u v = lgReduceAux u v
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      intro u v hfuel
      have hnn := dot_self_nonneg u
      have hzero : dot u u = 0 := by omega
      have hlt : ¬ dot (lgNext u v) (lgNext u v) < dot u u := by
        have := dot_self_nonneg (lgNext u v); omega
      rw [lgReduceAuxK, lgReduceAux, dif_neg hlt]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      intro u v hfuel
      rw [lgReduceAuxK, lgReduceAux]
      by_cases h : dot (lgNext u v) (lgNext u v) < dot u u
      · rw [if_pos h, dif_pos h]
        refine ih _ _ ?_
        have := dot_self_nonneg (lgNext u v)
        omega
      · rw [if_neg h, dif_neg h]

name: TunnellMap.lgReduceK_eq
statement: theorem lgReduceK_eq (u v : Triple) : lgReduceK u v = lgReduce u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [lgReduceK, lgReduce, lgReduceAuxK_eq _ u v le_rfl]

name: TunnellMap.OrthogonalFrame.ext'
statement:
theorem OrthogonalFrame.ext' {p : Triple} {F G : OrthogonalFrame p}
    (h₁ : F.e₁ = G.e₁) (h₂ : F.e₂ = G.e₂) (h₃ : F.z = G.z) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  cases F; cases G; cases h₁; cases h₂; cases h₃; rfl

name: TunnellMap.reduceFrameK_eq
statement:
theorem reduceFrameK_eq {p : Triple} (F : OrthogonalFrame p) :
    reduceFrameK F = reduceFrame F
proof:
:=
  OrthogonalFrame.ext' (by simp [reduceFrameK, reduceFrame, lgReduceK_eq])
    (by simp [reduceFrameK, reduceFrame, lgReduceK_eq]) rfl

name: TunnellMap.mem_wCandidates
statement: theorem mem_wCandidates {r z : ℤ} (h : 32 * (z * z) = r) : z ∈ wCandidates r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wCandidates, isqrtK_eq]
  have hzz : 0 ≤ z * z := mul_self_nonneg z
  have hr : ¬ r < 0 := by omega
  have hdiv : r / 32 = z * z := by
    rw [← h]
    exact Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (by norm_num)
  have hs : Int.sqrt (r / 32) = (z.natAbs : ℤ) := by rw [hdiv]; exact Int.sqrt_eq z
  have habs : ((z.natAbs : ℤ)) * ((z.natAbs : ℤ)) = z * z := Int.natAbs_mul_self' z
  rw [if_neg hr, hs, if_pos (by rw [habs]; exact h)]
  by_cases h0 : ((z.natAbs : ℤ)) = 0
  · rw [if_pos h0]
    have hz : z = 0 := by omega
    rw [hz]
    exact List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
  · rw [if_neg h0]
    have hcase : z = -(z.natAbs : ℤ) ∨ z = (z.natAbs : ℤ) := by omega
    rcases hcase with h' | h'
    · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl h')
    · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr (List.mem_singleton.mpr h'))

name: TunnellMap.mem_targetTriples
statement:
theorem mem_targetTriples {n : ℤ} {w : Triple} (h : aForm w = n) :
    w ∈ targetTriples n
proof:
:= by
  have hform : 2 * w.x ^ 2 + w.y ^ 2 + 32 * w.z ^ 2 = n := h
  have hn : 0 ≤ n := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg w.x, sq_nonneg w.y, sq_nonneg w.z]
  have hxsq : w.x ^ 2 ≤ n := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg w.y, sq_nonneg w.z]
  have hysq : w.y ^ 2 ≤ n := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg w.x, sq_nonneg w.z]
  obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := coordinate_bounds_of_sq_le hn hxsq
  obtain ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩ := coordinate_bounds_of_sq_le hn hysq
  refine List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨w.x, mem_intRangeSym hx₁ hx₂, ?_⟩
  refine List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨w.y, mem_intRangeSym hy₁ hy₂, ?_⟩
  refine List.mem_map.mpr ⟨w.z, ?_, rfl⟩
  refine mem_wCandidates ?_
  nlinarith [hform]

name: TunnellMap.mem_targetRosterUnsorted_iff
statement:
theorem mem_targetRosterUnsorted_iff {n : ℤ} (x : AResidual n) :
    x ∈ targetRosterUnsorted n ↔ IsTargetRosterTriple n x.1.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨w, -, hw⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hx
    by_cases h : IsTargetRosterTriple n w
    · rw [dif_pos h] at hw
      have : x.1.1 = w := by rw [← Option.some.inj hw]
      rw [this]; exact h
    · rw [dif_neg h] at hw; exact absurd hw (by simp)
  · intro h
    refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨x.1.1, mem_targetTriples h.1, ?_⟩
    rw [dif_pos h]
    rfl

name: TunnellMap.aLexLe_iff
statement:
theorem aLexLe_iff {n : ℤ} (a b : AResidual n) :
    ALexLe a b ↔ aResidualLexKey a ≤ aResidualLexKey b
proof:
:= by
  unfold ALexLe aResidualLexKey
  rw [Bool.not_eq_true', ← Bool.not_eq_true, tripleLexLtExec_iff, not_lt]

name: TunnellMap.mem_targetRosterExec_iff
statement:
theorem mem_targetRosterExec_iff {n : ℤ} (x : AResidual n) :
    x ∈ targetRosterExec n ↔ IsTargetRosterTriple n x.1.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [targetRosterExec, (List.perm_insertionSort _ _).mem_iff, List.mem_dedup,
    mem_targetRosterUnsorted_iff]

name: TunnellMap.targetRosterExec_nodup
statement: theorem targetRosterExec_nodup {n : ℤ} : (targetRosterExec n).Nodup
proof:
:=
  ((List.perm_insertionSort (ALexLe (n := n)) _).nodup_iff).mpr (List.nodup_dedup _)

name: TunnellMap.targetRosterExec_pairwise
statement:
theorem targetRosterExec_pairwise {n : ℤ} :
    (targetRosterExec n).Pairwise fun a b => aResidualLexKey a ≤ aResidualLexKey b
proof:
:= by
  refine List.Pairwise.imp ?_ (List.pairwise_insertionSort ALexLe _)
  intro a b hab
  exact (aLexLe_iff a b).mp hab

name: TunnellMap.canonical_of_mem_targetRosterExec
statement:
theorem canonical_of_mem_targetRosterExec {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    {x : AResidual n} (hx : x ∈ targetRosterExec n) :
    canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
      ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (mem_targetRosterExec_iff x).mp hx
  have hlt : aResidualLexKey x <
      aResidualLexKey ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).neg x) :=
    (tripleLexLtExec_iff x.1.1 (negTriple x.1.1)).mp h.2.2
  show (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).canonicalPoint aResidualLexKey x = x
  unfold FreeInvolution.canonicalPoint
  rw [if_pos hlt]

name: TunnellMap.mem_targetRosterExec_of_canonical
statement:
theorem mem_targetRosterExec_of_canonical {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    {x : AResidual n}
    (hx : canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
      ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit x) = x) :
    x ∈ targetRosterExec n
proof:
:= by
  have hcanon : (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).canonicalPoint aResidualLexKey x = x := hx
  have hlt : aResidualLexKey x <
      aResidualLexKey ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).neg x) := by
    unfold FreeInvolution.canonicalPoint at hcanon
    by_cases h : aResidualLexKey x <
        aResidualLexKey ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).neg x)
    · exact h
    · rw [if_neg h] at hcanon
      exact absurd hcanon ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).no_fixed x)
  refine (mem_targetRosterExec_iff x).mpr ⟨x.1.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← directTargetUsed_iff]; exact x.2
  · rw [tripleLexLtExec_iff]; exact hlt

name: TunnellMap.mem_targetRosterExec_iff_canonical
statement:
theorem mem_targetRosterExec_iff_canonical {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (x : AResidual n) :
    x ∈ targetRosterExec n ↔
      canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos
        ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit x) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨canonical_of_mem_targetRosterExec hnpos, mem_targetRosterExec_of_canonical hnpos⟩

name: TunnellMap.targetRosterExec_orbit_unique
statement:
theorem targetRosterExec_orbit_unique {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (q : (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit) :
    ∃! x : AResidual n, x ∈ targetRosterExec n ∧
      (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit x = q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos q, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · refine mem_targetRosterExec_of_canonical hnpos ?_
    rw [orbit_canonicalAResidualRepresentative]
  · exact orbit_canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos q
  · rintro y ⟨hy, rfl⟩
    exact (canonical_of_mem_targetRosterExec hnpos hy).symm

name: TunnellMap.coordinate_bounds_of_sq_le
statement:
theorem coordinate_bounds_of_sq_le {x n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hxn : x ^ 2 ≤ n) :
    -n ≤ x ∧ x ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · by_contra h
    have hx : n + 1 ≤ -x := by omega
    have hleft : 0 ≤ -x - (n + 1) := by omega
    have hright : 0 ≤ -x + (n + 1) := by omega
    have hprod := mul_nonneg hleft hright
    nlinarith
  · by_contra h
    have hx : n + 1 ≤ x := by omega
    have hleft : 0 ≤ x - (n + 1) := by omega
    have hright : 0 ≤ x + (n + 1) := by omega
    have hprod := mul_nonneg hleft hright
    nlinarith

name: TunnellMap.bRepBounded_injective
statement:
private theorem bRepBounded_injective (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (bRepBounded n)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Triple.ext
  · have hx := congrArg (fun r => r.1.1) h
    change p.1.x = q.1.x at hx
    exact hx
  · have hy := congrArg (fun r => r.2.1.1) h
    change p.1.y = q.1.y at hy
    exact hy
  · have hz := congrArg (fun r => r.2.2.1) h
    change p.1.z = q.1.z at hz
    exact hz

statement:
private theorem aRepBounded_injective (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (aRepBounded n)
proof:
:= by

  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Triple.ext
  · have hx := congrArg (fun r => r.1.1) h
    change p.1.x = q.1.x at hx
    exact hx
  · have hy := congrArg (fun r => r.2.1.1) h
    change p.1.y = q.1.y at hy
    exact hy
  · have hz := congrArg (fun r => r.2.2.1) h
    change p.1.z = q.1.z at hz
    exact hz

name: TunnellMap.GloballyRanked.preferenceList_pairwise
statement:
theorem preferenceList_pairwise (I : GloballyRanked K S T) (s : S) :
    (I.preferenceList s).Pairwise fun t₁ t₂ => I.rank s t₁ ≤ I.rank s t₂
proof:
:= by
  letI : LinearOrder T := LinearOrder.lift' (I.rank s) (I.source_injective s)
  exact Finset.pairwise_sort (Finset.univ : Finset T) (· ≤ ·)

name: TunnellMap.GloballyRanked.preferenceList_nodup
statement:
theorem preferenceList_nodup (I : GloballyRanked K S T) (s : S) :
    (I.preferenceList s).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  letI : LinearOrder T := LinearOrder.lift' (I.rank s) (I.source_injective s)
  exact Finset.sort_nodup (Finset.univ : Finset T) (· ≤ ·)

name: TunnellMap.GloballyRanked.mem_preferenceList
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_preferenceList (I : GloballyRanked K S T) (s : S) (t : T) :
    t ∈ I.preferenceList s
proof:
:= by
  letI : LinearOrder T := LinearOrder.lift' (I.rank s) (I.source_injective s)
  have h : t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset T).sort (α := T) (· ≤ ·) := by
    simp
  exact h

name: TunnellMap.GloballyRanked.length_preferenceList
statement:
@[simp] theorem length_preferenceList (I : GloballyRanked K S T) (s : S) :
    (I.preferenceList s).length = Fintype.card T
proof:
:= by
  letI : LinearOrder T := LinearOrder.lift' (I.rank s) (I.source_injective s)
  have h : ((Finset.univ : Finset T).sort (α := T) (· ≤ ·)).length = Fintype.card T := by
    simp
  exact h

name: TunnellMap.GloballyRanked.preferenceList_strict
statement:
theorem preferenceList_strict (I : GloballyRanked K S T) (s : S)
    {i j : Fin (I.preferenceList s).length} (hij : i < j) :
    I.rank s ((I.preferenceList s).get i) <
      I.rank s ((I.preferenceList s).get j)
proof:
:= by
  have hle := (I.preferenceList_pairwise s).rel_get_of_lt hij
  have htne : (I.preferenceList s).get i ≠ (I.preferenceList s).get j := by
    intro h
    exact (ne_of_lt hij) ((I.preferenceList_nodup s).injective_get h)
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne hle
  intro hrank
  exact htne (I.source_injective s hrank)

name: TunnellMap.tripleLexKey_injective
statement: theorem tripleLexKey_injective : Function.Injective tripleLexKey
proof:
:= by
  intro v w h
  apply Triple.ext
  · exact congrArg (fun k : TripleLexKey => (ofLex k).1) h
  · exact congrArg (fun k : TripleLexKey => (ofLex (ofLex k).2).1) h
  · exact congrArg (fun k : TripleLexKey => (ofLex (ofLex k).2).2) h

name: TunnellMap.bResidualLexKey_injective
statement:
theorem bResidualLexKey_injective {n : ℤ} :
    Function.Injective (bResidualLexKey (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact tripleLexKey_injective h

name: TunnellMap.aResidualLexKey_injective
statement:
theorem aResidualLexKey_injective {n : ℤ} :

proof:

  apply Subtype.ext

name: TunnellMap.representativeEdgeKey_eq_orbitEdgeKey
statement:
theorem representativeEdgeKey_eq_orbitEdgeKey {n : ℤ} (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (s : BResidual n) (t : AResidual n) :
    representativeEdgeKey s t =
      orbitEdgeKey hnpos ((bResidualInvolution n).orbit s)
        ((aResidualInvolution n hnpos).orbit t)
proof:
:= by
  let BI := bResidualInvolution n
  let AI := aResidualInvolution n hnpos
  let rs := canonicalBResidualRepresentative (BI.orbit s)
  let rt := canonicalAResidualRepresentative hnpos (AI.orbit t)
  have hsOrbit : BI.orbit rs = BI.orbit s := by
    exact BI.orbit_canonicalRepresentative bResidualLexKey
      bResidualLexKey_injective _
  have htOrbit : AI.orbit rt = AI.orbit t := by
    exact AI.orbit_canonicalRepresentative aResidualLexKey
      aResidualLexKey_injective _
  have hs : s = rs ∨ s = negBResidual rs := by
    change s = rs ∨ s = BI.neg rs
    exact BI.orbit_eq_iff.mp hsOrbit
  have ht : t = rt ∨ t = negAResidual rt := by
    change t = rt ∨ t = AI.neg rt
    exact AI.orbit_eq_iff.mp htOrbit
  change representativeEdgeKey s t = representativeEdgeKey rs rt
  rcases hs with hs | hs <;> rcases ht with ht | ht
  · rw [hs, ht]
  · rw [hs, ht]
    exact representativeEdgeKey_neg_target _ _
  · rw [hs, ht]
    exact representativeEdgeKey_neg_source _ _
  · rw [hs, ht, representativeEdgeKey_neg_source,
      representativeEdgeKey_neg_target]

name: TunnellMap.residualOrbitMatching_stable
statement:
theorem residualOrbitMatching_stable
    (hcard : Fintype.card (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit =
      Fintype.card (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit) :
    (residualOrbitRanking hnpos).Stable
      (residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Classical.choose_spec
    (GloballyRanked.exists_unique_stable (residualOrbitRanking hnpos) hcard)).1

name: TunnellMap.residualOrbitMatching_unique
statement:
theorem residualOrbitMatching_unique
    (hcard : Fintype.card (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit =
      Fintype.card (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit)
    (M : (bResidualInvolution n).Orbit ≃
      (aResidualInvolution n hnpos).Orbit)
    (hM : (residualOrbitRanking hnpos).Stable M) :
    M = residualOrbitMatching hnpos hcard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Classical.choose_spec
    (GloballyRanked.exists_unique_stable (residualOrbitRanking hnpos) hcard)).2 M hM

name: TunnellMap.dot_self_nonneg
statement: theorem dot_self_nonneg (v : Triple) : 0 ≤ dot v v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dot]
  nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg v.x, mul_self_nonneg v.y, mul_self_nonneg v.z]

name: TunnellMap.eq_zero_of_dot_self_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_dot_self_eq_zero {v : Triple} (h : dot v v = 0) :
    v = ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dot] at h
  have h1 := mul_self_nonneg v.x
  have h2 := mul_self_nonneg v.y
  have h3 := mul_self_nonneg v.z
  have hx : v.x = 0 := by nlinarith
  have hy : v.y = 0 := by nlinarith
  have hz : v.z = 0 := by nlinarith
  exact Triple.ext hx hy hz

name: TunnellMap.dot_negTriple_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem dot_negTriple_left (u v : Triple) :
    dot (negTriple u) v = - dot u v
proof: := by simp only [dot, negTriple]; ring

name: TunnellMap.dot_negTriple_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem dot_negTriple_right (u v : Triple) :
    dot u (negTriple v) = - dot u v
proof: := by simp only [dot, negTriple]; ring

name: TunnellMap.dot_negTriple_self
statement: theorem dot_negTriple_self (u : Triple) : dot (negTriple u) (negTriple u) = dot u u
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: TunnellMap.dot_vsub_vsmul
statement:
theorem dot_vsub_vsmul (u v : Triple) (q : ℤ) :
    dot u (vsub v (vsmul q u)) = dot u v - q * dot u u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dot, vsub, vsmul]; ring

name: TunnellMap.cross_vsub_vsmul
statement:
theorem cross_vsub_vsmul (u v : Triple) (q : ℤ) :
    cross u (vsub v (vsmul q u)) = cross u v
proof:
:= by
  apply Triple.ext <;> simp only [cross, vsub, vsmul] <;> ring

name: TunnellMap.cross_swap_neg
statement: theorem cross_swap_neg (u v : Triple) : cross v (negTriple u) = cross u v
proof:
:= by
  apply Triple.ext <;> simp only [cross, negTriple] <;> ring

name: TunnellMap.cross_neg_neg
statement:
theorem cross_neg_neg (u v : Triple) :
    cross (negTriple u) (negTriple v) = cross u v
proof:
:= by
  apply Triple.ext <;> simp only [cross, negTriple] <;> ring

name: TunnellMap.round_bound
statement:
theorem round_bound {a b : ℤ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    -a ≤ 2 * (b - nearestQuot b a * a) ∧ 2 * (b - nearestQuot b a * a) ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  unfold nearestQuot
  by_cases hb : 0 ≤ b
  · rw [if_pos hb]
    have hdiv := Int.mul_ediv_add_emod (2 * b + a - 1) (2 * a)
    have hlo : 0 ≤ (2 * b + a - 1) % (2 * a) := Int.emod_nonneg _ (by omega)
    have hhi : (2 * b + a - 1) % (2 * a) < 2 * a := Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ (by omega)
    generalize (2 * b + a - 1) / (2 * a) = Q at *
    generalize (2 * b + a - 1) % (2 * a) = R at *
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · rw [if_neg hb]
    have hdiv := Int.mul_ediv_add_emod (-(2 * b) + a - 1) (2 * a)
    have hlo : 0 ≤ (-(2 * b) + a - 1) % (2 * a) := Int.emod_nonneg _ (by omega)
    have hhi : (-(2 * b) + a - 1) % (2 * a) < 2 * a := Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ (by omega)
    generalize (-(2 * b) + a - 1) / (2 * a) = Q at *
    generalize (-(2 * b) + a - 1) % (2 * a) = R at *
    constructor <;> nlinarith

name: TunnellMap.nearestQuot_tie
statement:
theorem nearestQuot_tie {a b k : ℤ} (ha : 0 < a) (h : 2 * b = (2 * k + 1) * a) :
    nearestQuot b a = if 0 ≤ b then k else k + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : ∀ m : ℤ, (2 * a * m - 1) / (2 * a) = m - 1 := by
    intro m
    have : 2 * a * m - 1 = (2 * a - 1) + 2 * a * (m - 1) := by ring
    rw [this, Int.add_mul_ediv_left _ _ (by omega : (2 * a : ℤ) ≠ 0),
      Int.ediv_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega) (by omega)]
    omega
  unfold nearestQuot
  by_cases hb : 0 ≤ b
  · rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb]
    have : 2 * b + a - 1 = 2 * a * (k + 1) - 1 := by linarith
    rw [this, hstep]
    ring
  · rw [if_neg hb, if_neg hb]
    have : -(2 * b) + a - 1 = 2 * a * (-k) - 1 := by linarith
    rw [this, hstep]
    ring

name: TunnellMap.lgNext_bound
statement: theorem lgNext_bound (u v : Triple) : |2 * dot u (lgNext u v)| ≤ dot u u
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (dot_self_nonneg u) with h0 | hpos
  · have hu : u = ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ := eq_zero_of_dot_self_eq_zero h0.symm
    subst hu
    simp [lgNext, dot, vsub, vsmul]
  · have hval : dot u (lgNext u v) =
        dot u v - nearestQuot (dot u v) (dot u u) * dot u u := by
      rw [lgNext, dot_vsub_vsmul, lgQuot]
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := round_bound (a := dot u u) (b := dot u v) hpos
    rw [abs_le, hval]
    exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: TunnellMap.lgReduceAux_cross
statement:
theorem lgReduceAux_cross (u v : Triple) :
    cross (lgReduceAux u v).1 (lgReduceAux u v).2 = cross u v
proof:
:= by
  induction u, v using lgReduceAux.induct with
  | case1 u v h ih =>
      rw [lgReduceAux, dif_pos h, ih, cross_swap_neg, lgNext, cross_vsub_vsmul]
  | case2 u v h =>
      rw [lgReduceAux, dif_neg h]
      show cross u (lgNext u v) = cross u v
      rw [lgNext, cross_vsub_vsmul]

name: TunnellMap.lgNormalize_cross
statement:
theorem lgNormalize_cross (uv : Triple × Triple) :
    cross (lgNormalize uv).1 (lgNormalize uv).2 = cross uv.1 uv.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold lgNormalize
  split
  · exact cross_neg_neg _ _
  · rfl

name: TunnellMap.lgSwap_cross
statement:
theorem lgSwap_cross (uv : Triple × Triple) :
    cross (lgSwap uv).1 (lgSwap uv).2 = cross uv.1 uv.2
proof:
:=
  cross_swap_neg uv.1 uv.2

name: TunnellMap.lgSelect_cross
statement:
theorem lgSelect_cross (uv : Triple × Triple) :
    cross (lgSelect uv).1 (lgSelect uv).2 = cross uv.1 uv.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold lgSelect
  split
  · rw [lgNormalize_cross, lgSwap_cross]
  · exact lgNormalize_cross uv

name: TunnellMap.lgReduce_cross
statement:
theorem lgReduce_cross (u v : Triple) :
    cross (lgReduce u v).1 (lgReduce u v).2 = cross u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [lgReduce, lgSelect_cross, lgReduceAux_cross]

name: TunnellMap.lgReduceAux_reduced
statement: theorem lgReduceAux_reduced (u v : Triple) : IsReducedPair (lgReduceAux u v)
proof:
:= by
  induction u, v using lgReduceAux.induct with
  | case1 u v h ih =>
      rw [lgReduceAux, dif_pos h]
      exact ih
  | case2 u v h =>
      rw [lgReduceAux, dif_neg h]
      exact ⟨lgNext_bound u v, not_lt.mp h⟩

name: TunnellMap.lgNormalize_reduced
statement:
theorem lgNormalize_reduced {uv : Triple × Triple} (h : IsReducedPair uv) :
    IsReducedPair (lgNormalize uv)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lgNormalize
  split
  · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp only [dot_negTriple_left, dot_negTriple_right, neg_neg] at * <;>
      [exact h₁; exact h₂]
  · exact h

name: TunnellMap.lgSwap_reduced
statement:
theorem lgSwap_reduced {uv : Triple × Triple} (h : IsReducedPair uv)
    (heq : dot uv.1 uv.1 = dot uv.2 uv.2) : IsReducedPair (lgSwap uv)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, -⟩ := h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show |2 * dot uv.2 (negTriple uv.1)| ≤ dot uv.2 uv.2
    rw [dot_negTriple_right, dot_comm uv.2 uv.1, ← heq, mul_neg, abs_neg]
    exact h₁
  · show dot uv.2 uv.2 ≤ dot (negTriple uv.1) (negTriple uv.1)
    rw [dot_negTriple_self]
    exact le_of_eq heq.symm

name: TunnellMap.lgSelect_reduced
statement:
theorem lgSelect_reduced {uv : Triple × Triple} (h : IsReducedPair uv) :
    IsReducedPair (lgSelect uv)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lgSelect
  split
  · rename_i hcond
    have heq : dot uv.1 uv.1 = dot uv.2 uv.2 := by
      simpa using (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp hcond |>.1
    exact lgNormalize_reduced (lgSwap_reduced h heq)
  · exact lgNormalize_reduced h

name: TunnellMap.lgReduce_reduced
statement: theorem lgReduce_reduced (u v : Triple) : IsReducedPair (lgReduce u v)
proof:
:=
  lgSelect_reduced (lgReduceAux_reduced u v)

name: TunnellMap.reduceFrame_e₁
statement:
@[simp] theorem reduceFrame_e₁ (F : OrthogonalFrame p) :
    (reduceFrame F).e₁ = (lgReduce F.e₁ F.e₂).1
proof: := rfl

name: TunnellMap.reduceFrame_e₂
statement:
@[simp] theorem reduceFrame_e₂ (F : OrthogonalFrame p) :
    (reduceFrame F).e₂ = (lgReduce F.e₁ F.e₂).2
proof: := rfl

name: TunnellMap.reduceFrame_z
statement:
@[simp] theorem reduceFrame_z (F : OrthogonalFrame p) :
    (reduceFrame F).z = F.z
proof: := rfl

name: TunnellMap.isLagrangeGaussReduced_reduceFrame
statement:
theorem isLagrangeGaussReduced_reduceFrame (F : OrthogonalFrame p) :
    IsLagrangeGaussReduced (reduceFrame F)
proof:
:=
  lgReduce_reduced F.e₁ F.e₂

name: TunnellMap.reduceFrame_alpha_square_bound
statement:
theorem reduceFrame_alpha_square_bound (F : OrthogonalFrame p) :
    3 * alpha (reduceFrame F) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * dot p p
proof:
:=
  reduced_alpha_square_bound _ (isLagrangeGaussReduced_reduceFrame F)

name: TunnellMap.reduceFrame_alpha_le_two_sqrt_div_three
statement:
theorem reduceFrame_alpha_le_two_sqrt_div_three (F : OrthogonalFrame p) :
    (alpha (reduceFrame F) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt ((dot p p : ℝ) / 3)

  reduced_alpha_le_two_sqrt_div_three _ (isLagrangeGaussReduced_reduceFrame F)

name: TunnellMap.reduceFrame_unimodular
statement:
theorem reduceFrame_unimodular (F : OrthogonalFrame p) (hp : p ≠ ⟨0, 0, 0⟩) :
    ∃ a b c d : ℤ, a * d - b * c = 1 ∧
      (reduceFrame F).e₁ = span2 a b F.e₁ F.e₂ ∧
      (reduceFrame F).e₂ = span2 c d F.e₁ F.e₂
proof:
:=
  frame_change_unimodular F (reduceFrame F) hp

name: TunnellMap.reduceFrame_same_lattice
statement:
theorem reduceFrame_same_lattice (F : OrthogonalFrame p) (r : Triple) :
    (∃ a b : ℤ, r = span2 a b F.e₁ F.e₂) ↔
      (∃ a b : ℤ, r = span2 a b (reduceFrame F).e₁ (reduceFrame F).e₂)
proof:
:=
  frame_same_lattice F (reduceFrame F) r

name: TunnellMap.reduceFrame_gram_det
statement:
theorem reduceFrame_gram_det (F : OrthogonalFrame p) :
    dot (reduceFrame F).e₁ (reduceFrame F).e₁ * dot (reduceFrame F).e₂ (reduceFrame F).e₂ -
        dot (reduceFrame F).e₁ (reduceFrame F).e₂ ^ 2 = dot p p
proof:
:=
  (reduceFrame F).gram_det

name: TunnellMap.lgReduce_deterministic
statement:
theorem lgReduce_deterministic {u v u' v' : Triple} (hu : u = u') (hv : v = v') :
    lgReduce u v = lgReduce u' v'
proof: := by rw [hu, hv]

name: TunnellMap.reduceFrame_deterministic
statement:
theorem reduceFrame_deterministic {p q : Triple} (F : OrthogonalFrame p)
    (G : OrthogonalFrame q) (h₁ : F.e₁ = G.e₁) (h₂ : F.e₂ = G.e₂) :
    ((reduceFrame F).e₁, (reduceFrame F).e₂) =
      ((reduceFrame G).e₁, (reduceFrame G).e₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reduceFrame_e₁, reduceFrame_e₂, reduceFrame_e₁, reduceFrame_e₂, h₁, h₂]

name: TunnellMap.RecordDA.terminalRunK_eq
statement:
theorem terminalRunK_eq (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hsq : Squarefree n) (fuel : ℕ)
    (hfuel : FuelSuffices hsq fuel) :
    terminalRunK hsq fuel = terminalRunExec (framesExec hsq)
proof:
:= by
  rw [terminalRunK, runK_eq hn _ fuel _ (genStarted_initial _) hfuel,
    terminalRunExec, framesExecK_eq]

name: TunnellMap.RecordDA.residualMapExecK_eq
statement:
theorem residualMapExecK_eq (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hnpos : 0 < n) (hsq : Squarefree n)
    (fallback : AResidual n) (fuel : ℕ) (hfuel : FuelSuffices hsq fuel)
    (x : BResidual n) :
    residualMapExecK hnpos hsq fallback fuel x =
      residualMapExec hnpos hsq fallback x
proof:
:= by
  rw [residualMapExecK, residualMapExec, terminalRunK_eq hn hsq fuel hfuel]
  rfl

name: TunnellMap.RecordDA.inverseByRerunExecK_eq
statement:
theorem inverseByRerunExecK_eq (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hsq : Squarefree n)
    (fallback : BResidual n) (fuel : ℕ) (hfuel : FuelSuffices hsq fuel)
    (y : AResidual n) :
    inverseByRerunExecK hsq fallback fuel y =
      inverseByRerunExec hsq fallback y
proof:
:= by
  rw [inverseByRerunExecK, inverseByRerunExec, terminalRunK_eq hn hsq fuel hfuel]

name: TunnellMap.oddMapExecK_eq
statement:
theorem oddMapExecK_eq (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hnpos : 0 < n) (hsq : Squarefree n)
    (fallback : AResidual n) (fuel : ℕ)
    (hfuel : RecordDA.FuelSuffices hsq fuel) (q : BOddRep n) :
    oddMapExecK hnpos hsq fallback fuel q = oddMapExec hnpos hsq fallback q
proof:
:= by
  unfold oddMapExecK oddMapExec
  by_cases hd : SourceUsedTriple q.1
  · rw [dif_pos hd, dif_pos hd]
  · rw [dif_neg hd, dif_neg hd,
      RecordDA.residualMapExecK_eq hn hnpos hsq fallback fuel hfuel]

name: TunnellMap.paperTunnellMapExecK_eq
statement:
theorem paperTunnellMapExecK_eq (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (hsq : Squarefree n) (fallback : AResidual n) (fuel : ℕ)
    (hfuel : RecordDA.FuelSuffices hsq fuel) (p : BRep n) :
    paperTunnellMapExecK hnpos hsq fallback fuel p =
      paperTunnellMapExec hnpos hsq fallback p
proof:
:= by
  unfold paperTunnellMapExecK paperTunnellMapExec
  by_cases h : p.1.z % 2 = 0
  · rw [dif_pos h, dif_pos h]
  · rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h]
    exact oddMapExecK_eq hn hnpos hsq fallback fuel hfuel
      ⟨p.1, p.2, Int.odd_iff.mpr (by omega)⟩
